2026-10-12.headline: 从几何、无序到拓扑：多体与材料体系中的对称性、涨落与输运
2026-10-12.overview: 本期论文横跨量子多体、拓扑物态、材料计算与器件模拟，共同关注对称性、几何与涨落如何决定可观测响应。一条线索是几何与量子度规：弯曲界面、平带淬火、化学键与激子相互作用均表明动量空间结构可被局域测量或调控。另一条线索是阻挫与无序：磁性Wigner晶体、阻挫轨道磁性与位点混合体系显示集体模式、配对与自旋动力学对无序和阻挫高度敏感。输运方面，非局域约瑟夫森耦合、反常霍尔响应与非线性输运给出可检验的器件级信号。方法上，神经网络求解重整化群、条件扩散预测加工与图机器学习筛选催化剂，反映计算工具正被用于连接微观参数与宏观性能。

themes.title: 几何与量子度规决定激发与响应
themes.summary: 多篇工作把能带或界面的几何量作为可观测量的来源：弯曲导体-介电界面的几何势可调控标量表面等离激元的有效质量并影响类比黑洞准正模；平带淬火协议通过局域占据读出提取积分量子距离与量子度规；化学键被表述为量子几何张量，非共线三中心键可贡献贝里曲率；激子-激子相互作用理论在非平庸量子度规平带中给出与无量子几何情形显著不同的双激子谱。这些结果共同指向动量空间几何对激发谱和输运的约束，但多数为理论推导，实验验证有限。

themes.title: 阻挫、无序与涨落重塑磁性与配对
themes.summary: 磁性Wigner晶体的集体模式在时间反演破缺下需超过有限阈值才能配对，手性p波为主导不稳定性；阻挫拓扑轨道磁性将几何阻挫与Aharonov-Bohm通量结合，产生轨道磁多极序与可测霍尔现象；YbZn2GaO5中Ga/Zn位点混合与晶体电场随机性下动态自旋涨落仍持续至最低测量温度；NiRuMnGa的B2型无序导致铁磁与反铁磁交换竞争，稳定团簇玻璃态而非长程有序。这些工作显示无序与阻挫既可抑制也可稳定特定集体态，但定量边界多依赖近似。

themes.title: 拓扑与反常输运的器件级信号
themes.summary: 手性Lifshitz费米子的反常霍尔响应由费米环缠绕数W决定，σxy^anom=(W/2)e^2/h，多层Haldane模型中W=2,3,4对应不同量子化值；石墨烯多端约瑟夫森网络在切换电流附近出现负微分纵向电阻，网络模型需包含非局域约瑟夫森耦合与非局域正常态电导；非均匀应变Bi2Se3单晶片实现10^4 μm/V非线性响应度，归因于经典几何非线性输运；掺杂碲中手性异常负磁阻可调并在极端量子极限下反转。这些结果提供可检验的输运特征，但材料与几何依赖性仍需独立验证。

themes.title: 计算方法连接微观参数与宏观性能
themes.summary: 物理信息神经网络可在不依赖大N近似下学习有效势对温度、场和尺度的依赖；条件扩散模型学习FIB铣削加工结果的统计分布，预测边缘形貌、线宽变化与缺陷概率；WWL-GPR在掺杂ZrO2表面反应中间体能量预测上优于线性标度关系，经微观动力学传播后CH3OH产率更接近DFT；基于晶体不变量的级联计算揭示GNoME数据集中意外规模的重复，并提出AI宣称新材料前应满足的必要条件。这些工作强调数据表示与验证边界，而非单纯精度提升。

themes.title: 对称性破缺与非常规序参量
themes.summary: SmB6表面近藤杂化振幅的时间反演奇分量在约10 K凝聚，产生面外表面磁化并打开狄拉克表面态能隙；BiFeO3的回旋磁序在室温下本征实现p波磁性，非相对论性自旋劈裂约100 meV，CPGE响应符号可电控切换；交变磁体α-MnTe沿[-1,1,0]施加约2 T面内磁场可使取向畴趋于近单一取向，2 K下Mn有序磁矩4.62(8) μB；交变磁性可调控电荷-4e超导，在交错与均匀电荷-2e态之间产生有限电荷-4e区域。这些结果把非常规序参量与可测磁光、中子或输运信号关联，但部分结论依赖模型或非极化衍射的局限。

2026-10-12.caveat: 阅读时需核对：多数理论工作未给出实验验证或具体材料参数，如弯曲界面等离激元、交替激子、平带量子几何提取与阻挫拓扑轨道磁性；部分数值结果依赖特定近似，如磁性Wigner晶体的Hartree-Fock与准玻色子近似、非马尔可夫Ising模型的横向场排除、氢化物库仑赝势的RPA与压力范围；实验类工作需核对样品条件与统计，如α-MnTe非极化衍射不能区分畴重布居与Néel矢量旋转、SmB6表面磁性依赖平均场计算、YbZn2GaO5的QSL证据仅来自NMR与μSR；计算筛选类需核对数据库版本、训练集规模与可迁移性，如GNoME重复规模、ZrO2催化剂仅限特定掺杂与表面、C–B手性材料尚未验证合成；器件与算法类需核对噪声、误差缓解与统计细节，如量子处理器准粒子对撞的21格点42量子比特设置、全晶体管变压器的仿真性质与交叉熵损失依赖。所有结论仅覆盖输入摘要，不应外推为领域趋势。

2026-10-08.headline: 从超材料到量子器件：结构、拓扑与统计的多尺度设计
2026-10-08.overview: 本期论文横跨声学超材料、量子材料、统计物理与机器学习辅助计算，共同问题是如何在复杂相互作用或多尺度结构中提取可控的自由度。不同路线包括：以几何或对称性设计宏观响应（五模晶格、准晶界面、矢量光束）；以拓扑与对称性分类量子态（陈绝缘体、边缘激子、非阿贝尔零模）；以统计与场论方法刻画无序、相变和输运（渗流、BKT、玻璃势垒）；以及用机器学习或变分方法降低计算成本。多数结果基于理论、模拟或单一体系，实验验证程度不一。

themes.title: 几何与对称性设计宏观响应
themes.summary: 五模晶格通过细纤维连接实现高体积模量，并给出屈曲极限的闭式预测；扭转SrTiO3薄膜构建八重与十二重准晶界面；矢量光束实现微米尺度实时晶体对称性监测。这些工作共同表明，几何排布与对称性可独立于材料化学调控声学、电子与光学响应。

themes.title: 拓扑量子态与边缘/缺陷模式
themes.summary: 非厄米损耗与非互易耦合协同诱导陈绝缘体；圆偏振驱动下不同SSH堆叠构造产生不同Floquet拓扑相；二维分子晶体中激子能带拓扑产生动量锁定的边缘激子；非阿贝尔FQH-SC异质结中零模算符区分隧穿融合道。这些结果从不同平台展示拓扑分类对边界态和输运的约束。

themes.title: 无序、相变与统计输运
themes.summary: 层级晶格渗流表明有限替代乘法维度不能完全决定临界指数普适类；长程耦合下BKT涡旋屏蔽给出σ>7/4的稳定判据；平均场玻璃模型中激活势垒与塑性起始分布呈幂律渐近；非晶硅中异常大的均方根涨落谐波模式决定热输运。这些工作从统计与场论角度刻画无序体系中的临界与输运行为。

themes.title: 机器学习与变分方法加速材料计算
themes.summary: 等变图神经网络直接预测动态极化率张量，下游器件载流子产生率与TD-DFT一致；深度学习代理模型优化多晶微结构，预测误差小于3%且评估时间减少约四个数量级；双自旋扇区VQE解决阻挫自旋系统态序反转；低秩环境Ring-DMRG提升周期系统张量环优化效率。这些方法共同目标是降低高保真模拟的计算成本。

themes.title: 量子器件中的输运与相干控制
themes.summary: 边缘接触方案在深埋Ge量子阱上实现近单位界面透明度与量子化超电流；栅压使超导纳米线相位滑移逃逸率增强六个数量级且对极性非对称；里德堡原子阵列用Ising哈密顿量模拟XXZ模型并探测XY与Ising相；几何热泵浦在超导量子处理器上提取与驱动轮廓相关的热贡献。这些结果展示不同量子平台上输运与相干调控的实验进展。

2026-10-08.caveat: 阅读时需注意：多数结果基于摘要，未核实全文；部分结论依赖特定模型、参数范围或近似（如大N极限、局域近似、精确推断、单色散less声子模）；实验类工作未给出统计样本量、误差棒或长期稳定性；机器学习预测的泛化边界和训练数据覆盖未明确；理论预测（如热中子响应、催化筛选）尚缺实验验证；跨论文联系仅基于摘要所述机制，不代表领域共识或趋势。

papers.title: Necessary conditions for benchmarking next-generation AI in materials discovery
papers.abstract: Current AI predicts materials by speeding up energy minimisation and training on large databases. However, scaling data generation prevents manual analysis by domain experts. If novelty is evaluated by chemical compositions or traditional representations in Crystallographic Information Files, or standard structure matchers based on manually chosen thresholds, one can easily generate millions of ``new'' compositions or files without discovering truly novel materials. This paper uses a hierarchy of crystal invariants to continuously trace and quantify structural novelty based on the new mathematical definition of a crystal structure and asymptotic guarantees for invariant descriptors. The invariant-based analysis through cascade computations on a modest computer exposes the unexpected scale of duplication in the world's largest materials databases, shown here in the high-profile case of GNoME datasets. To prevent current ``embarrassment of over-prediction'', we propose necessary conditions for next-generation AI that should be automatically enforced before claiming any new materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算，基于数学定义与不变量分析。；研究对象：晶体结构不变量与GNoME等大型材料数据库。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于晶体不变量级联计算，作者发现全球最大材料数据库中存在意外规模的重复，并据此提出下一代AI宣称新材料前应自动满足的必要条件。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何避免仅凭化学组成、传统CIF表示或标准结构匹配器阈值就生成大量“新”材料，从而无法发现真正新颖材料的问题。
证据与比较：摘要称通过级联计算在普通计算机上对GNoME数据集进行不变量分析，暴露了世界最大材料数据库中的意外重复规模；未提供具体重复数量或统计指标。
papers.method_zh: 使用晶体不变量层级，基于晶体结构的新数学定义和不变描述符的渐近保证，进行级联计算。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出基于新数学定义和渐近保证的晶体不变量层级，用于连续追踪和量化结构新颖性，并据此提出下一代AI的必要条件。

papers.title: Potential energy release rate for solids with bounded domains during evolutions involving changes to boundaries and boundary data
papers.abstract: We investigate the rate of change of equilibrium potential energy for nonlinear elastic solids undergoing evolutions that may involve changes in body geometry, material properties, applied tractions, and prescribed displacements. We represent such an evolution by a one-parameter family of variational problems and identify a class of these families for which the potential-energy release rate is well defined. Particular attention is given to the formulation of the potential energy at each evolution state: each constituent variational problem must yield the appropriate equilibrium state, while its equilibrium value must also correctly represent the physical change in potential energy between states. Within this framework, we derive a closed-form expression for the potential-energy release rate for solids with bounded domains, allowing for spatially nonuniform material evolution, sharp material interfaces, and evolving boundary geometry and prescribed boundary data. The expression is determined entirely by the equilibrium solution at the state under consideration and by the quantities prescribing the local evolution, so neighboring equilibrium problems need not be solved. Finally, we apply the result to the extension of a notch in a two-dimensional elastic body and show that the resulting potential-energy release rate reduces to the classical $J$-integral.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于变分框架推导公式；研究对象：有界域非线性弹性固体，含演化边界与边界数据
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对有界域非线性弹性固体的演化，势能释放率可由当前平衡解和局部演化量显式表达，无需解邻近平衡问题。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何定义并计算有界域非线性弹性固体在几何、材料、载荷和位移演化过程中的势能释放率？
证据与比较：摘要给出闭式表达式，并应用于二维弹性体缺口扩展，显示所得势能释放率退化为经典J积分。

papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称表达式完全由当前平衡解和局部演化量决定，无需解邻近平衡问题，并允许非均匀材料演化、尖锐界面和演化边界。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件；仅提及二维缺口扩展算例，未提供数值验证或实验数据。

papers.title: Doubly Metastable Synthesis for Accelerated Quantum Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: New physics emerges from new materials, which in turn rely on the development of new synthesis techniques. Identifying the enlargement of metastable synthesis window as enabling for realizing novel materials, we develop diffusion-activated epitaxy, a technique which combines two metastable synthesis methods of diffusion and epitaxy. We observe that within a narrow window of investigated synthesis space we can experimentally identify the stabilization of four distinct phases, three of which show X-ray diffraction and scanning transmission electron microscopy characterization data that are incompatible with the crystal structures registered in experimental and computational inorganic structure databases. These results suggest an enlarged metastable synthesis window is enabled by this synthesis approach, identifying doubly metastable synthesis as a promising method for exploration of quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验，摘要描述合成与表征实验；研究对象：扩散激活外延合成的四种不同物相，其中三种晶体结构未见于数据库
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩散激活外延在窄合成窗口内稳定了四种不同物相，其中三种的XRD和STEM数据与现有实验及计算无机结构数据库中的晶体结构不兼容。

研究问题：能否通过结合扩散与外延两种亚稳合成方法，扩大亚稳合成窗口，从而发现新物相以探索量子材料。

papers.title: Robust Golden Ratio universality as a consequence of a circulant symmetry
papers.abstract: We find a robust scenario for the emergence of the Golden Ratio (GR) dynamical universality class, characterized by the dynamical exponent $z \equiv \varphi=\frac{1}{2}(1+\sqrt{5})$. Previously, its emergence required fine-tuning of system parameters. Here, the GR universality class appears generically in a wide class of Markov processes as a consequence of a global, circulant symmetry of the flux Jacobian. This symmetry leads to GR universality in systems where the total number of conservation laws is odd and larger than three. We introduce a multilane exclusion process with Bernoulli stationary measure as a minimal, parameter-free model, which features GR universality for all conserved modes, most of which are doubly degenerate. Our predictions, based on mode-coupling theory generalized to treat degenerate conserved modes, are corroborated by large-scale Monte Carlo simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论结合大规模蒙特卡洛模拟，摘要明确提及两者。；研究对象：具有循环对称性的多车道排斥过程，守恒律数为奇数且大于三。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 循环对称性使黄金比动力学普适类在守恒律数为奇数且大于三的马尔可夫过程中无需精细调节而稳健出现。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何在不精细调节系统参数的情况下，使黄金比动力学普适类在更广泛的马尔可夫过程中普遍出现？
证据与比较：基于推广至简并守恒模式的模式耦合理论预测，并由大规模蒙特卡洛模拟证实；模型为无参数多车道排斥过程，具有伯努利稳态测度，所有守恒模式均呈现黄金比普适性，其中多数为双重简并。
papers.method_zh: 推广的模式耦合理论处理简并守恒模式，结合大规模蒙特卡洛模拟。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称黄金比普适类作为通量雅可比矩阵全局循环对称性的结果，在守恒律数为奇数且大于三的系统中普遍出现，并引入无参数最小模型。

papers.title: Phononic Frequency Combs in Twisted Bilayer Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Heterostructures from First Principles
papers.abstract: Phononic frequency combs are equidistant spectral ladders generated when a driven vibrational mode transfers energy to an autoparametrically excited subharmonic mode through anharmonic intermode coupling. In previous studies, the coupling strength governing this energy transfer has typically been treated as a free parameter, extracted from a fabricated device, or adopted from an earlier calculation for a specific mode pair. As a result, whether a given crystal can support a phononic frequency comb, and the drive strength required to generate it, has not been predictable a priori. Here we obtain the complete parameter set from density functional theory. Twisted bilayers of \MoSSe{} and \MoSMoSe{} at the commensurate angle $21.787^{\circ}$ adopt space group $P3$ in a 42-atom \rootseven{} moiré supercell. The second-order force constants provide the mode frequencies; the third-order constants provide the linewidths through the Boltzmann transport equation and hence the quality factors; and the same third-order tensor projected onto the phonon eigenvectors of a chosen mode pair provides the anharmonic couplings $\kt$ and $\kss$. Both bilayers constitute a mode pair within $0.8\%$ of the $2\!:\!1$ resonance with $ω_1/ω_2 = 1.9923$ in \MoSSe{} and $1.9943$ in \MoSMoSe{}. By integrating the resulting two-mode equations, both modes generate combs through a discontinuous transition: at $701\,\fth$ in \MoSSe{} the envelope variance rises from $2.1\times10^{3}$ to $1.37\times10^{4}$ and the tooth count of mode 1 from 7 to 16 within a single $5\,\fth$ increment, identifying the onset as subcritical. The spectral entropy peaks \emph{before} this jump, at $341\,\fth$. The two compounds carry comparable coupling, differing by a factor of $1.2$. However, the comb excitation threshold is set by the quality-factors of signal modes: $Q_2 = 672$ for \MoSSe{} and $Q_2 = 3844$ for \MoSMoSe{}.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算；研究对象：21.787°扭转的双层MoSSe和MoSMoSe异质结
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种扭转双层均可支持声子频率梳，其激发阈值由信号模式品质因子决定，而非由非谐耦合强度主导。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否从第一性原理预测给定晶体是否支持声子频率梳以及所需驱动强度，而非将耦合强度作为自由参数。
证据与比较：模式对频率比接近2:1（MoSSe为1.9923，MoSMoSe为1.9943）；MoSSe在701 fth处包络方差从2.1×10^3跃升至1.37×10^4，模式1齿数从7增至16；谱熵峰值在341 fth；两种化合物耦合相差1.2倍；Q2分别为672和3844。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论计算二阶力常数得模式频率，三阶力常数结合玻尔兹曼输运方程得线宽和品质因子，并将三阶张量投影到声子本征矢得非谐耦合，再积分双模方程。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称首次从密度泛函理论获得完整参数集，使声子频率梳的可支持性和驱动强度可先验预测，而非依赖自由参数或器件提取。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要仅涉及21.787°扭转角和42原子超胞的两种特定异质结；未说明其他角度、温度或更复杂体系是否适用；未提供实验验证信息。

papers.title: Replica Transition at Measurement-Altered Ising Criticality
papers.abstract: Performing measurements on gapless quantum ground states can give rise to new universal phenomena, whose origins remain poorly understood even for the paradigmatic Ising critical point. Replica methods offer a natural framework to study such post-measurement ensembles, with the replica limit $Q\to 1$ describing physical Born-averaged observables. Here we show that, for the monitored critical Ising chain, the replicated post-measurement ensemble of states itself undergoes a phase transition precisely at the physically relevant replica limit $Q \to 1$, preventing standard replica treatments. We use boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) methods to explain the underlying mechanism of this transition. Our methods yield a perturbative analytic calculation of the universal $O(1)$ constant in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record, previously known only numerically. We also apply our tools to study measurement-averaged spin correlators, providing a unified description of the universal properties of measurement outcomes and post-measurement states in the critical Ising chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于BCFT的解析计算；研究对象：监测临界Ising链及其测量后复制品系综
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 监测临界Ising链的复制品测量后系综在物理相关复制品极限Q→1处发生相变，阻碍标准复制品处理。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何理解测量对无能隙量子基态产生的普适现象，特别是临界Ising点测量后系综的复制品方法失效问题。
证据与比较：通过BCFT方法解析计算了测量记录Shannon熵中的普适O(1)常数，此前仅数值已知；并应用于测量平均自旋关联函数。
papers.method_zh: 边界共形场论（BCFT）方法，进行微扰解析计算。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称揭示了复制品极限Q→1处发生相变，阻止标准复制品处理，并首次解析计算Shannon熵普适常数。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件及无法核实的信息。

papers.title: Improved screening of doped ZrO$_2$ catalysts for CO$_2$ hydrogenation from graph-based machine learning
papers.abstract: Dopants can tune the activity of zirconia-based CO$_2$ hydrogenation catalysts through changes in adsorbate and transition-state (TS) energetics. Computing these quantities with density functional theory (DFT) becomes expensive when several dopants, reaction intermediates, and TSs must be screened. Here, we further develop the graph-based machine learning method Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman Gaussian Process Regression (WWL-GPR): we introduce additional electronic-structure and local-environment features relevant for oxide surfaces and use the resulting model to predict adsorption and TS energies on ZrO$_2$(101) surfaces doped with Al$^{3+}$, Cd$^{2+}$, Ga$^{3+}$, In$^{3+}$, and Zn$^{2+}$. Adsorbate-surface structures are represented as attributed graphs that combine bonds connectivity and features. We benchmark WWL-GPR against thermodynamic scaling relations (TSR) for reaction intermediates and Bronsted-Evans-Polanyi relations (BEP) for TSs, and then propagate the predicted energies to microkinetic CH$_3$OH-yield estimates. WWL-GPR consistently improves the prediction of reaction intermediate energetics relative to linear scaling approaches and provides TS estimates that are competitive with BEP-based models. These improvements become especially relevant when the predicted energetics are propagated through the reaction network. Microkinetic calculations show that WWL-GPR-derived energies give CH$_3$OH yields closer to DFT-derived yields than the linear-relation workflow. Degree-of-rate-control analysis links the activity errors to dopant-dependent rate-controlling steps, including HCOO* formation, H$_2$COOH* dissociation, and H$_3$CO* formation. These results support WWL-GPR as a data-efficient surrogate for connecting atomistic energetics with catalyst-screening observables on doped oxide surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；基于DFT数据训练机器学习模型并做微观动力学分析；研究对象：Al³⁺、Cd²⁺、Ga³⁺、In³⁺、Zn²⁺掺杂的ZrO₂(101)表面CO₂加氢催化剂
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WWL-GPR在预测掺杂ZrO₂表面反应中间体能量上优于线性标度关系，其预测能量经微观动力学传播后给出的CH₃OH产率比线性关系流程更接近DFT结果。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何以数据高效的方式替代昂贵的DFT计算，快速筛选多种掺杂ZrO₂催化剂上CO₂加氢的吸附能与过渡态能量？
证据与比较：将WWL-GPR与反应中间体的热力学标度关系和过渡态的BEP关系进行基准比较；把预测能量输入微观动力学模型估算CH₃OH产率，并与DFT推导产率对比；通过速率控制度分析将活性误差关联到掺杂剂依赖的速控步骤。
papers.method_zh: 在WWL-GPR中引入针对氧化物表面的电子结构和局域环境特征，以属性图表示吸附物-表面结构，预测吸附能和过渡态能量，并进行微观动力学模拟。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称进一步开发了WWL-GPR，引入适用于氧化物表面的额外电子结构和局域环境特征，并将其用于掺杂ZrO₂表面的吸附与过渡态能量预测。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要仅涉及ZrO₂(101)表面及Al³⁺、Cd²⁺、Ga³⁺、In³⁺、Zn²⁺掺杂；未说明训练集规模、泛函选择、温度压力条件及模型在其他氧化物或反应中的可迁移性。

papers.title: Scalene Yang-Baxter triples realize all nearest-neighbour Hamiltonians with global additive symmetries
papers.abstract: We establish that bond Hamiltonian densities, up to local difference terms whose sum vanishes under periodic boundary conditions, lying in the commutant of bond operators, $w_j\pm w_{j+1}$, is a necessary and sufficient condition for a one-dimensional nearest-neighbour Hamiltonian to conserve a uniform or staggered sum of the one-site operators $w_j$. Starting from these local commutants, we show that every such Hamiltonian and its conserved charge can be obtained from monodromy matrices constructed using regular and non-regular members of scalene Yang-Baxter triples. The results hold on periodic chains of length $L\geq3$, with even length required in the staggered case. The results do not require translation invariance, and hence the interaction on each bond can be chosen independently from the full corresponding commutant. Our representation-independent construction applies in arbitrary finite local dimension and exhausts the Hamiltonians with either prescribed additive symmetry, without requiring ordinary Yang-Baxter integrability. We illustrate the construction with spin-$\tfrac12$ and spin-1 systems and discuss its relation to the double-commutant theorem. Classifying the one-site generators $w$ and their associated bond commutants provides a route to classifying such Hamiltonians with additive conserved charges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于数学构造与定理证明；研究对象：一维最近邻哈密顿量，具有全局加性对称性，任意有限局域维度
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 键哈密顿量密度在键算符交换子中，是守恒均匀或交错单点算符和的充要条件；此类哈密顿量及其守恒荷可由不等边Yang-Baxter三元组的单值矩阵构造。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何刻画和构造所有具有全局加性守恒荷的一维最近邻哈密顿量，而不要求平移不变性或普通Yang-Baxter可积性？
证据与比较：摘要给出充要条件证明，构造适用于周期链L≥3，交错情形需偶数长度；不要求平移不变性，每个键的相互作用可独立选自相应交换子；构造在任意有限局域维度成立，并穷尽具有指定加性对称性的哈密顿量。
papers.method_zh: 基于键算符交换子、不等边Yang-Baxter三元组的正则与非正则成员构造单值矩阵，并讨论与双交换子定理的关系。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称构造与表示无关，适用于任意有限局域维度，穷尽具有指定加性对称性的哈密顿量，且不要求普通Yang-Baxter可积性。
papers.limitations_zh: 结果限于一维周期链L≥3，交错情形需偶数长度；摘要未明确说明非周期边界、更高维度或具体物理实现条件。

papers.title: Arrested phase separation and amorphous patterns in charged binary fluids
papers.abstract: Frustration generated by competing interactions can stabilise patterns with tunable lengthscales which evade indefinite coarsening and macroscopic phase separation. Here we investigate a charged binary fluid in which the tendency toward phase separation is opposed by screened electrostatic repulsion. Combining analytics and numerical simulations, we identify a regime of arrested phase separation characterised by finite-wavelength instability. The resulting states include droplet and labyrinthine phases in two dimensions, and droplets, concentric shells and tubular structures in three dimensions. Surprisingly, some of these structures are amorphous morphologies that emerge reproducibly from different initial conditions. Free-energy estimates suggest that these disordered structures may be thermodynamically stabilised by frustration, rather than being kinetically trapped. Our results identify a simple mechanism through which the competition between phase separation and screened electrostatics can generate equilibrium amorphous microphases with glassy features.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合；结合解析分析与数值模拟；研究对象：带电荷的二元流体，相分离趋势与屏蔽静电排斥相竞争
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相分离与屏蔽静电排斥竞争下，体系出现有限波长不稳定性导致的受阻相分离，形成液滴、迷宫、同心壳层和管状等结构，其中部分无定形形貌可从不同初始条件重复出现，自由能估计提示其可能由阻挫热力学稳定化而非动力学俘获。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：带电荷二元流体中，相分离趋势与屏蔽静电排斥的竞争如何产生有限波长不稳定性、受阻相分离以及可重复的无定形微相？
证据与比较：摘要报告：结合解析与数值模拟识别出有限波长不稳定性主导的受阻相分离区间；二维得到液滴和迷宫相，三维得到液滴、同心壳层和管状结构；部分无定形形貌从不同初始条件可重复出现；自由能估计提示这些无序结构可能被阻挫热力学稳定化。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析与数值模拟相结合，研究带电荷二元流体中相分离与屏蔽静电排斥的竞争。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者在摘要中称，结果识别出一种简单机制，通过相分离与屏蔽静电竞争的竞争可产生具有玻璃态特征的平衡无定形微相。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体参数范围、样品条件、定量自由能数值及实验验证情况；无定形结构的热力学稳定性仅由自由能估计提示，摘要未明确说明是否排除动力学俘获。

papers.title: Shear-driven arrest of dip-coating film entrainment
papers.abstract: A plate withdrawn from a bath of partially wetting liquid entrains a film above a critical velocity. Here, we show that this critical threshold can be substantially increased by the presence of a laminar gas flow opposed to the plate velocity that exerts a tangential shear stress on the liquid-gas interface. Using two-phase immiscible Navier-Stokes simulations and confining the gas to a narrow channel, we derive a closed-form expression for the interfacial stress, which combined with lubrication theory relates the thickness of the film and the contact line velocity to the applied shear stress. As the gas velocity is increased, the film thins and the contact line velocity slows down, until the imposed shear overcomes the drag of the moving plate and entrainment is arrested. As in the quiescent case, the velocity mismatch between plate and contact line is independent of the plate velocity and is set by the applied shear alone. We find that one set of varying gas flow simulations, with constant critical plate velocity, therefore determines the critical gas flow for every smaller plate velocity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算，基于两相不可混溶Navier-Stokes模拟；研究对象：部分润湿液体中提拉镀膜的气-液界面与接触线
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 与板运动方向相反的层流气流施加切向剪切应力，可显著提高薄膜夹带的临界速度，直至夹带被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何通过施加与提拉方向相反的层流气体剪切应力来抑制或阻止部分润湿液体在提拉镀膜中的薄膜夹带？
证据与比较：模拟显示随气体速度增加，薄膜变薄且接触线速度减慢；推导出界面应力的闭式表达式，结合润滑理论关联膜厚、接触线速度与施加剪切；发现板与接触线速度差仅由施加剪切决定，与板速无关。
papers.method_zh: 两相不可混溶Navier-Stokes模拟，将气体限制在窄通道内，结合润滑理论推导闭式表达式。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称通过层流气体剪切可大幅提高临界阈值并抑制夹带，且一组变气流模拟可确定更小板速下的临界气流。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料、通道尺寸、模拟参数范围及实验验证情况；结论基于模拟和理论推导。

papers.title: Dislocation mediated twin boundary faceting in $β$-Sn
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs), including twin boundaries (TBs), play a critical role in plastic deformation by interacting with dislocations. The deformation and strengthening mechanisms in $β$-Sn are of significant interest because Sn-based alloys are widely used as solder materials. Recent experiments have shown deformation-induced faceting in $β$-Sn arising from twin-dislocation interactions. Using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations informed by a recently developed machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP), we demonstrate a $\langle c\rangle$ dislocation-absorption mediated faceting reaction along $(301)$ TBs in $β$-Sn in which facet length grows with the number of absorbed dislocations. We show that the predicted facet length is consistent with isotropic elasticity theory only when the disclination character of the asymmetric twin facet is taken into account. We discuss analogies to faceting reactions in other low symmetry metals and hypothesize that the ubiquity of $(301)$ twins in $β$-Sn stems from their ability to grow rapidly through a forest of dislocation obstacles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；使用分子动力学模拟和机器学习势函数。；研究对象：β-Sn中的(301)孪晶界
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿(301)孪晶界的<c>位错吸收介导的刻面反应，刻面长度随吸收位错数增加；预测刻面长度需考虑非对称孪晶刻面的向错特征才与各向同性弹性理论一致。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：β-Sn中(301)孪晶界如何通过位错吸收发生刻面？刻面长度与吸收位错数的关系及理论描述。
证据与比较：分子动力学模拟显示刻面长度随吸收位错数增加；预测刻面长度与各向同性弹性理论比较，仅在考虑非对称孪晶刻面的向错特征时一致。
papers.method_zh: 基于近期开发的机器学习原子间势的分子动力学模拟。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称展示了<c>位错吸收介导的(301)孪晶界刻面反应，并指出需考虑向错特征才能与弹性理论一致。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明模拟条件、材料参数及实验验证；未提供具体数字和样品条件。

papers.title: A new approach to the Kondo effect: sophomore's dream function and Lee-Yang zeros
papers.abstract: We develop an analytical approach to the Kondo problem based on an effective partition function that generalizes the sophomore's dream integral. The Kondo crossover is represented as a passage through an approximately equidistant ladder of its Lee-Yang zeros in the complex plane, rather than as a singularity on the real axis. Summation over this ladder yields the Gamma function $Γ(α+ T_K/(2 πT))$ as the universal crossover backbone, where the offset $α=1/2$ is fixed by the Friedel sum rule. The Euler-Maclaurin expansion connects the discrete zero structure to the Nozieres Fermi-liquid theory through Bernoulli numbers. A two-cutoff formula provides a compact, essentially one-parameter description of the full crossover in terms of a temperature-space Fano lineshape which is a thermal average of the energy-space Fano resonance observed in STM. Drift corrections are treated. The approach extends to $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ Coqblin-Schrieffer, underscreened and Anderson impurity models, and Kondo lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于解析推导与模型扩展；研究对象：近藤问题及相关杂质模型（SU(N) Coqblin-Schrieffer、欠屏蔽、Anderson杂质、近藤晶格）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 近藤交叉可用复平面上Lee-Yang零点梯的求和描述，其普适骨架为Gamma函数Γ(α+T_K/(2πT))，α=1/2由Friedel求和规则固定。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何用Lee-Yang零点梯和sophomore's dream积分推广的解析框架统一描述近藤交叉，并连接费米液体理论？
证据与比较：摘要给出：零点梯近似等距；求和得到Gamma函数骨架；Euler-Maclaurin展开通过Bernoulli数与Nozières费米液体理论连接；双截断公式给出温度空间Fano线型，为STM能量空间Fano共振的热平均；处理漂移修正。
papers.method_zh: 基于推广sophomore's dream积分的有效配分函数解析方法，结合Lee-Yang零点求和、Euler-Maclaurin展开和双截断公式。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称提出基于Lee-Yang零点梯的新解析方法，将近藤交叉表示为复平面零点穿越而非实轴奇点，并给出普适Gamma函数骨架。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件、参数范围或近似误差；未提供与实验或数值的定量比较；未说明对具体材料的适用性。

papers.title: Parametric Glassiness in Graphene-based Electronic Lévy Glass
papers.abstract: Complex disordered conductors can display highly structured and parameter-sensitive transport even in the absence of a thermodynamically stable glass phase. Overlap distributions originally developed for replica symmetry breaking (RSB) provide a useful diagnostic of this organization, provided that their interpretation is distinguished from the equilibrium Parisi construction. In this study, we report RSB-like overlap phenomenology and parametric mesoscopic glassiness in a graphene-based electronic Lévy glass, a device that mimics optical phenomena via electronic processes. By tuning the Fermi energy, we can control the number of propagating wave modes and observe reentrant changes from narrowly centered to broad or bimodal overlap distributions. The phenomenology is observed in both graphene-based and conventional two-dimensional electron-gas electronic Lévy glasses, indicating its generality. Sample-resolved overlap distributions show that the effect is intrinsic to each disorder landscape, whereas the normalized conductance variance shows that the growth of the absolute variance is mainly caused by the increasing mean conductance. We therefore interpret the overlap as a measure of correlation among hierarchically organized transport pathways and the reentrant behavior as evidence of pinning, parameter-induced reorganizations, and mesoscopic chaos in coherent transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究；基于器件输运测量与重叠分布分析。；研究对象：石墨烯基电子Lévy玻璃及传统二维电子气电子Lévy玻璃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨烯基电子Lévy玻璃中观察到类RSB重叠现象和参数介观玻璃性，通过调节费米能量可控制传播波模式数并出现从窄中心到宽或双峰重叠分布的回归变化。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：复杂无序导体在无热力学稳定玻璃相时能否表现出高度结构化且参数敏感的输运，以及重叠分布能否作为诊断工具。
证据与比较：摘要提供：调节费米能量控制传播波模式数；观察到窄中心、宽和双峰重叠分布的回归变化；现象在石墨烯基和传统二维电子气电子Lévy玻璃中均出现；样品分辨重叠分布显示效应内禀于每个无序景观；归一化电导方差显示绝对方差增长主要由平均电导增加引起。
papers.method_zh: 通过调节费米能量控制传播波模式数，测量重叠分布和归一化电导方差，在石墨烯基和传统二维电子气电子Lévy玻璃中进行比较。

papers.title: Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Motion, Stability, and Frequency Responses under Different Screening-Charge Conservation Laws
papers.abstract: We analyze ferroelectric domain wall motion, shape, and internal structure arising from coupling between polarization and screening charge. Universal cases are organized by electrical boundary conditions, charge conservation and dynamics, and polarization free energy. We consider exposed surfaces, interfaces beneath a dielectric layer and top electrode, and interfaces with a blocking mixed ionic-electronic conductor. Screening occurs through local exchange, exchange with lateral transport, or strictly conserved redistribution. Analytical derivations and finite-depth calculations establish screening drag, velocity branches, and conditions for spatial instability. For an isolated wall joining differently compensated domains, strict surface conservation and zero far-field current exclude steady translation of the screening profile, while allowing transient displacement, finite-sample arrest, and charge-balanced structural changes. Conservation also constrains long-distance transport around a moving junction in an adjoining conductor. Large-field simulations in the top-electrode geometry reveal nonlinear corrugation, transfer toward longer wavelengths, and coupled polarization rotation. First-order polarization energetics allow two interphase fronts enclosing a paraelectric core; multiaxial polarization permits wall rotation and competing intermediate ferroelectric domains. A driven structural-screening reduction supports stable periodic behavior. Reduced-variable diagrams summarize motion and structural regimes, while BaTiO3 and BiFeO3 examples connect them to material thermodynamics. Small-signal analysis distinguishes displacement, polarization, and electrostatic response functions. These results provide a framework for wall dynamics and structural transitions under different driving and screening conditions.

papers.title: Altermagnetic Control of Charge-4e Superconductivity
papers.abstract: We present, to our knowledge, the first theoretical realization of an independent charge-4e phase in a two-dimensional classical array of conventional superconductors coupled through altermagnetic junctions. Tuning the altermagnetic splitting suppresses the leading single-pair tunneling harmonic while retaining strong double-pair coupling, producing a finite charge-4e region between staggered and uniform charge-2e states. Using the complete temperature-dependent microscopic Josephson spectrum, we find short-range ordinary pair correlations alongside algebraic coherence of pairs of Cooper pairs. Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless scaling and a half-flux response further identify the charge-4e phase. Our results establish altermagnetism as a microscopic means to select between ordinary and composite superconducting coherence.

papers.title: Giant geometric nonlinear transport in inhomogeneously strained Bi$_2$Se$_3$ single crystalline slabs
papers.abstract: Electrical transport in non-centrosymmetric materials exhibits a nonlinear conductivity tensor component that generates second-harmonic voltages in response to applied electric fields. Harnessing this effect is essential for developing zero-threshold electromagnetic energy harvesters and broadband frequency upconverters, both of which require maximizing the nonlinear responsivity. Here, we demonstrate that inhomogeneously strained macroscopic slabs of the topological insulator Bi$_2$Se$_3$ achieve a record-high nonlinear responsivity of $10^4\,μ$m/V: a six orders of magnitude boost compared to its thin-film counterparts. We attribute this giant enhancement to a classical geometric nonlinear transport effect, which is driven by complex strain gradients within the bulk material. Notably, a similar geometric mechanism known as geometric nonlinear Hall was previously observed only in microscale-patterned structures. Our findings establish macroscopic strain engineering as a powerful route to enhance nonlinear transport, with immediate relevance to a broad class of layered systems, including transition metal dichalcogenides and moiré heterostructures.

papers.title: How Fluctuations Control Chiral Symmetry Breaking in Reacting Mixtures of Chiral Molecules
papers.abstract: The pronounced chiral asymmetry of biomolecules is a defining feature of living systems, yet the mechanisms by which such asymmetry emerged remain unresolved. Chiral symmetry breaking may have occurred under prebiotic conditions in systems with sufficiently small molecular populations for intrinsic fluctuations to play an important role. Here, we investigate how finite-population fluctuations affect chiral-state selection, the characteristic time for symmetry breaking, and stochastic switching between chiral states in a system driven by autocatalysis and mutual antagonism. We determine how these dynamical processes scale with particle number and derive an analytical expression for the probability of selecting either chiral state as a function of the initial enantiomeric bias. We further calculate the mean selection time for different initial biases and show that, for weak mutual antagonism, fluctuations can induce transitions between opposite chiral states. These results characterize how finite-population fluctuations control both the emergence and stability of molecular chirality in autocatalytic chemical systems.

papers.title: Latin squares as a model of perfect mixing of high-entropy alloys
papers.abstract: The structure of high-entropy alloys, which include 5 or more components in equimolar proportions, is proposed to be described in the mathematical language of Latin squares. This model is fundamentally discrete and allows for a quantitative description of ideal mixing, in which any given alloy element is guaranteed not to have an identical element as its nearest neighbor. For the two-dimensional case, the model possesses four axes of translational symmetry, which makes it possible to tile the plane with a single Latin square and, based on the properties of this square, describe the properties of macroscopic material samples. The model makes it possible to make quantitative estimates of the suitability of a particular atomic structure (configuration) for implementation in a perfectly mixed high-entropy alloy with maximum mixing entropy. A condition has been obtained for acceptable fluctuations in the concentration of components at which the thermodynamic stability of the alloy is maintained. The possibility of identifying superstructures in high-entropy alloys based on group theory, as applied to the description and construction of Latin squares, is discussed. Based on the proposed model, the probability of forming a multicomponent alloy with ideal mixing is estimated. For a five-component alloy, this probability is no more than 2.6*10^{-10}.

papers.title: Graph-theoretic framework for semi-Markov networks: transient and stationary occupation probabilities, hitting times and weak ergodicity breaking
papers.abstract: Semi-Markov networks provide a natural framework for describing stochastic transitions between coarse-grained states with non-exponential dwell times, with applications ranging from biophysics and neuroscience to epidemiology and finance. Here, it is shown that finite semi-Markov networks admit explicit combinatorial representations of their Laplace-transformed occupation probabilities and hitting-time distributions as sums over weighted spanning trees and forests of an augmented graph. These representations yield asymptotic results, including a generalization of the Markov Chain Tree Theorem to semi-Markov networks, in which the rate constants replaced by pseudo-rates given by the inverse mean sojourn time weighted by the exit probability through this channel, as well as the long-time scaling of hitting-time survival probabilities in the presence of infinite-mean sojourn times. They also extend recently derived combinatorial formulas for hitting-time moments to the semi-Markov setting. In particular, the mean hitting-time formula coincides with that of a Markov network with the corresponding pseudo-rates, which also yields a short proof of the constancy of Kemeny's constant for finite-mean semi-Markov networks. Finally, we use the same framework to show that weak ergodicity breaking occurs generically for time-additive state observables that are nonconstant on the support of the limiting distribution in heavy-tailed semi-Markov networks.

papers.title: The effects of non-stoichiometric lattice structure and secondary phase α-Fe2O3 on modifying the magnetic, electrical, and magneto-electric properties of Eu doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrite
papers.abstract: The Ba-atoms in BaFe12O19 were substituted by Eu-atoms to prepare the material of composition Ba1-xEuyFe12O19. The Eu atoms occupied at the sites of Fe atoms. The atomic ratio of Eu/Ba were varied from 0 to 0.33 to control the secondary phase (hematite) and M-type hexaferrite. Raman spectra provided complimentary support for a systematic increase of the hematite phase on increasing the Eu/Ba ratio. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy informed the presence of oxygen deficiency and surface defects, and charge state of Ba and Fe/Eu ions close to +2 and +3, respectively. The material showed direct optical transitions with band gap in the range of 2.25-3.09 eV. The increase of Eu/Ba ratio systematically increased the saturation magnetization from 84.44 emu g-1 to 57.68 emu g-1 at 3 K and 67.09 emu g-1 to 43.42 emu g-1 at 300 K, along with remarkable enhancement of the coercivity (914- 3656 Oe at 3 K and 1996-4862 Oe at 300 K). Electrical conductivity increased from 10-11-10-10 Sm-1 at 30 K to 10-5 -10-4 Sm-1 at 300 K. The electrical conductivity analysis reveals the Efros-Shklovsky-type variable-range hopping mechanism at the low-temperature region, whereas the Mott variable range hopping mechanism is applicable near to room temperature. The analysis of current-voltage characteristics provided electrode to sample interfacial barrier height of 0.27-0.74 eV. The material exhibited novel magneto-electronic properties (bi-stable electronic switching and its transformation in the temperature scale, magnetoresistance and magnetoelectric coupling) which are highly useful for spintronic devices. This work demonstrates that controlled Eu/Ba atomic ratio in the stoichiometric and non-stoichiometric lattice structure could be an effective strategy to widely tune the magnetic, optical and magneto-electronic properties in M-type Ba hexaferrite material.

papers.title: A new device for live cell imaging of biological samples under in-plane shear
papers.abstract: The effect of mechanical stresses and deformations upon the behavior and properties of cells and tissues is a topic of paramount interest in the field of biophysics. Its understanding is essential for deepening our comprehension of cellular responses to environmental stimuli, with implications in fields ranging from embryogenesis to tumor development. For boosting the understanding in this field, it is important to develop devices for the application of simple deformations in order to probe the cellular response to the basic mechanical transformations. While a number of stretching devices have been developed, in-plane shearing deformation has been little investigated. Here, a new device is introduced that allows the application of homogeneous in-plane shear upon a cell monolayer while imaging the sample with a commercial optical microscope. A description of the faced experimental challenges is reported and a full characterization is presented. It is demonstrated the capability of the device to apply reproducible, controlled and homogeneous shear of both single cells and confluent cellular monolayers.

papers.title: Controlling the Atomic Reconstruction in Twisted MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ with a Monolayer hBN Spacer
papers.abstract: Twisted van der Waals heterobilayers are a promising material platform for studying collective exciton many-body phenomena, but near-aligned structures often exhibit a local, anisotropic atomic reconstruction that compromises lateral homogeneity. The present study describes how atomic-scale rearrangement in adjacent regions of hBN-encapsulated, near-aligned MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers is controlled by the presence of a mono- or bilayer hBN spacer between the two monolayers. High-angle annular dark-field STEM directly resolves the atomic alignment in both layers and shows that the spacer suppresses the reconstruction and strongly increases the structural uniformity of the heterobilayers. 4D-STEM quantitatively maps local rotation, dilation, and heterostrain, revealing that the separated regions remain consistent with rigid moiré superlattice simulations, whereas without the spacer the structural parameters have two to three times broader distributions. By suppressing reconstruction, ultrathin hBN spacers therefore provide an effective route to enhance lattice homogeneity in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers targeting collective excitonic and optoelectronic phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；摘要提及HAADF-STEM和4D-STEM测量；研究对象：hBN封装的近对齐MoSe2/WSe2扭转异质双层，含单层或双层hBN间隔层
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近对齐MoSe2/WSe2异质双层间插入单层或双层hBN间隔层可抑制原子重构，显著提高结构均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何控制近对齐扭转MoSe2/WSe2异质双层中局部各向异性原子重构，以改善其横向均匀性。
证据与比较：HAADF-STEM直接分辨两层原子排列；4D-STEM定量映射局部旋转、膨胀和异质应变；有间隔层时结构参数与刚性莫尔超晶格模拟一致，无间隔层时分布宽2至3倍。
papers.method_zh: 对hBN封装的近对齐MoSe2/WSe2异质双层进行高角环形暗场STEM和4D-STEM表征，并与刚性莫尔超晶格模拟比较。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称超薄hBN间隔层通过抑制重构，为增强MoSe2/WSe2异质双层晶格均匀性提供了有效途径。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明间隔层厚度、扭转角范围、样品制备细节及统计样本量；结论限于所研究的近对齐MoSe2/WSe2体系。

papers.title: Magnetic-field-induced detwinning of orientational domains in altermagnet $α$-MnTe: A single-crystal neutron diffraction study
papers.abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, which makes them promising for future spintronic and magnonic applications, but their macroscopic responses can be strongly reduced by domain averaging. In hexagonal $α$-MnTe, three symmetry-related in-plane Néel-vector orientations and their time-reversal counterparts form six magnetic domain states, complicating both magnetic structure determination and measurements of the chiral magnon response. Using single-crystal neutron diffraction, we show that an in-plane field applied along the $[-1,1,0]$ direction produces a common magnetic domain orientation that saturates near $μ_0H=2$ T. A constrained refinement of 61 nuclear and magnetic reflections collected at 2 K and 2 T yields $\mathbf{M}\parallel[1,1,0]$, an ordered moment of $4.62(8)~μ_\mathrm{B}$ per Mn, and an orientational domain population at $r_A:r_B:r_C=0.97:0.03(5):0$ that is compatible with a nearly complete alignment of orientational domains. Furthermore, an abnormal behaviour in the temperature dependence of the selected reflections is observed in 60-88 K, its microscopic origin is discussed within the context of possible intrinsic piezomagnetic or magnetoelastic effects. Because unpolarized diffraction neither distinguishes domain repopulation from continuous Néel-vector rotation nor resolves time-reversal antiphase domains, the field-prepared state is a near-single-orientation state rather than a truly single-domain state. This non-contact domain control provides a practical complement to strain and field-cooling approaches for preparing well-defined magnetic states in bulk $α$-MnTe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；单晶中子衍射测量；研究对象：六角α-MnTe单晶的磁畴取向与磁结构
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿[-1,1,0]方向施加面内磁场可在约2 T使α-MnTe的取向畴趋于近单一取向，2 K、2 T下M∥[1,1,0]，Mn有序磁矩4.62(8) μB。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何通过磁场控制α-MnTe中六个磁畴态的取向分布，以获得便于磁结构测定和手性磁振子测量的确定磁态。
证据与比较：2 K、2 T下收集61个核与磁反射进行约束精修，得到M∥[1,1,0]、Mn有序磁矩4.62(8) μB及取向畴布居r_A:r_B:r_C=0.97:0.03(5):0；并在60-88 K观察到所选反射温度的异常行为。
papers.method_zh: 单晶非极化中子衍射，面内磁场沿[-1,1,0]施加，对2 K、2 T下61个核与磁反射做约束精修。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称该非接触畴控制为制备块体α-MnTe确定磁态提供了对应变和场冷方法的实用补充。
papers.limitations_zh: 非极化衍射不能区分畴重新布居与连续Néel矢量旋转，也不能分辨时间反演反相畴，因此场制备态是近单一取向态而非真正单畴态；60-88 K异常的微观起源仅为可能的内在压磁或磁弹效应讨论。

papers.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
papers.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. These predictions accurately reproduce edge morphology, linewidth variations, and defect probabilities observed in fabricated samples, enabling statistical analysis of milling performance and the identification of dominant structural and process parameter-dependent deformation modes. The work establishes a probabilistic modelling framework for fabrication variability analysis and fabrication-aware design optimization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/建模研究；摘要提出条件扩散模型，未报告实验验证。；研究对象：聚焦离子束（FIB）铣削加工的微纳结构及其加工变异分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 条件扩散模型可学习以输入设计为条件的加工结果统计分布，预测出真实样本中观察到的边缘形貌、线宽变化和缺陷概率。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何建模FIB铣削中由烧蚀速率波动和再沉积等系统与随机效应导致的加工结果分布，而非仅预测单一确定性结果。
证据与比较：摘要称预测能准确复现加工样品中观察到的边缘形貌、线宽变化和缺陷概率，并支持铣削性能统计分析与参数相关变形模式识别；未给出具体定量指标或样本数。
papers.method_zh: 提出条件扩散模型，以输入设计为条件学习加工结果的统计分布，用于预测可能输出样本结构的现实分布。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称现有铣削模型通常只预测单一确定性结果而忽略变异性，本文建立面向加工变异分析和加工感知设计优化的概率建模框架。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用材料、工艺参数范围、训练数据规模及实验验证条件；RSS片段可能截断，未提供全文核实信息。

papers.title: VN-GraphGG: von Neumann--Mullins--based graph grain growth simulation
papers.abstract: Efficient simulations of grain growth are essential for investigating the process-structure-property relationships in polycrystalline materials. We introduce a two-dimensional von Neumann-Mullins-based graph grain growth simulation (VN-GraphGG), which couples the grain-scale kinetics with microstructure reconstruction. The polycrystalline microstructure is represented as a graph with grain and junction nodes. The grain-area evolution on the grain graph is governed by the von Neumann--Mullins (VN) law, while a graph neural network is trained to reconstruct the microstructure from the graph. This separation allows kinetic coefficients to be varied without retraining the neural reconstruction model. Topological changes during grain growth such as disappearance of grains and changes in neighbor relations are handled straightforwardly through reconstruction and postprocessing. Simulations demonstrate accurate predictions of VN kinetics and coarsening statistics, and significant speedup over the phase-field simulations. The proposed method provides a foundation for efficient grain growth simulation based on grain-scale kinetics, opening the way to incorporate a broader range of physical mechanisms. An application example is presented for abnormal grain growth, in which kinetic heterogeneity significantly influences the grain microstructure evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算模拟，摘要描述图神经网络与VN动力学耦合的数值方法；研究对象：二维多晶材料晶粒生长，以图结构表示晶粒与结点
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出VN-GraphGG方法，将晶粒尺度动力学与图神经网络微结构重构分离，能准确预测VN动力学与粗化统计，并较相场模拟显著加速。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何高效模拟多晶材料晶粒生长，并在不重新训练重构模型的情况下改变动力学系数、处理拓扑变化？
证据与比较：摘要称模拟展示了VN动力学的准确预测和粗化统计，并相对相场模拟有显著加速；给出异常晶粒生长应用示例，其中动力学非均匀性显著影响晶粒微结构演化。
papers.method_zh: 二维von Neumann-Mullins基图晶粒生长模拟；多晶微结构表示为含晶粒与结点节点的图；晶粒面积演化由VN定律控制；训练图神经网络从图重构微结构。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称该方法将晶粒尺度动力学与微结构重构分离，使动力学系数可变而无需重新训练神经重构模型，并为纳入更广泛物理机制提供基础。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要仅涉及二维模拟；未明确说明适用材料、温度、时间尺度、定量误差、加速倍数及图神经网络泛化条件；异常晶粒生长示例的具体参数未给出。

papers.title: The Stone-Wales trefoil: a new topological defect in graphene
papers.abstract: Specific heat of graphite at high temperatures demonstrates significant deviation from the ``3R'' Dulong-Petite law. It can be explained by accumulation of defects with formation energy as low as 1.45 eV. Based on the density functional theory calculations, we propose a possible candidate of topological defects, whose energy is comparable to the growth activation energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算，基于密度泛函理论计算。；研究对象：石墨烯中的拓扑缺陷，与石墨高温比热异常相关。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种名为Stone-Wales三叶结的拓扑缺陷，其形成能低至1.45 eV，可解释石墨高温比热对杜隆-珀蒂定律的偏离。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：石墨高温比热显著偏离3R杜隆-珀蒂定律，需要寻找形成能足够低的缺陷来解释这一异常。
证据与比较：摘要提到石墨高温比热显著偏离3R杜隆-珀蒂定律，并给出缺陷形成能低至1.45 eV；未提供具体比热数据、温度范围或对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论计算，评估候选拓扑缺陷的能量。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出Stone-Wales三叶结是石墨烯中一种新的拓扑缺陷候选，其能量与生长激活能相当。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明计算参数、适用温度范围及实验验证情况；RSS片段可能截断，未提供全文细节。

papers.title: Temperature evolution of spin dynamics in extended Kitaev models within an Abrikosov fermion theory beyond mean field
papers.abstract: The $S=1/2$ Kitaev model provides an exactly solvable setting in which spin fractionalization produces itinerant Majorana fermions coupled to an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge field. In realistic Kitaev magnets, however, non-Kitaev interactions break integrability and make their finite-temperature dynamics difficult to calculate. We develop a finite-temperature parton mean-field theory based on the Abrikosov-fermion representation and incorporate the effects of exchange interactions through the random phase approximation to calculate the dynamical spin structure factor. For the pure Kitaev model, the method reproduces a strong, nearly dispersionless peak at a finite low energy together with a broad continuum at higher energies. It also reproduces the momentum dependence of the dynamical spin structure factor and its temperature evolution, including the downward shift of the low-energy spectral weight, in qualitative agreement with continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo calculations. Within the present theory, the contraction of the continuum is traced to the temperature-induced reduction of the bond amplitudes, which narrows the parton bands and compresses the two-parton phase space. For ferromagnetic Kitaev coupling, the energy of the low-energy peak is minimized at the $Γ$ point for a ferromagnetic Heisenberg interaction and maximized there for an antiferromagnetic interaction. In the ferromagnetic Kitaev-$Γ$ model, the static response develops a finite-momentum softening, indicating an instability toward the period-three magnetic order reported in numerical studies. For uniform-ferromagnetic states selected by a $[111]$ magnetic field, we find that a broad parton continuum coexists with magnonlike dispersive structures, producing spectral features consistent with a spinon-to-magnon crossover.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算；基于Abrikosov费米子表示和RPA的有限温度部分子平均场理论；研究对象：扩展Kitaev模型，包括纯Kitaev、铁磁Kitaev-Γ模型及[111]磁场下的均匀铁磁态
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论再现了纯Kitaev模型动力学自旋结构因子的低能峰和高能连续谱及其温度演化，并将连续谱收缩归因于温度诱导的键振幅减小；在扩展模型中预测了低能峰能量极值、有限动量软化及自旋子-磁振子交叉。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何计算非Kitaev相互作用破坏可积性后扩展Kitaev磁体的有限温度自旋动力学？
证据与比较：纯Kitaev模型的结果与连续时间量子蒙特卡洛计算定性一致，包括动量依赖和温度演化；铁磁Kitaev耦合下低能峰能量在Γ点随海森堡相互作用符号变化；铁磁Kitaev-Γ模型中静态响应出现有限动量软化；[111]磁场下均匀铁磁态中部分子连续谱与磁振子色散共存。
papers.method_zh: 基于Abrikosov费米子表示的有限温度部分子平均场理论，并通过随机相近似纳入交换相互作用效应，计算动力学自旋结构因子。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出将Abrikosov费米子部分子平均场与随机相近似结合，用于计算扩展Kitaev模型的有限温度动力学自旋结构因子。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明该理论的具体适用条件（如温度范围、相互作用强度限制）及近似误差；未提供与实验的直接对比。

papers.title: Quantitative Eshelby stability: local and finite-shape theory through AI-assisted mechanics
papers.abstract: How can human researchers use artificial intelligence (AI) to make progress on difficult mechanics problems while retaining control of physical significance, mathematical rigor, and validation? We explore this opportunity through a quantitative stability problem rooted in the Eshelby conjecture. For a uniform dilatational eigenstrain in a homogeneous isotropic solid, we establish a nonlinear two-sided relation between whole-interior strain heterogeneity and a geometry-only distance from the ellipsoid family, with half-order Sobolev scaling that captures morphological length scale. We then develop a complementary finite-shape theory: ellipsoidal subtraction yields an exact residual-field budget from which systematically convergent upper and lower bounds are obtained for a prescribed geometry. Applied to protruded, indented, and necked inclusions, the bounds agree with independent displacement-based finite-element calculations. The study also documents a human-led, AI-assisted research process in which researchers select consequential problems, shape targets, audit arguments, require independent checks, and interpret mechanics, while AI broadens analytical exploration and supports computation. This experience also led us to develop Open Problems in Mechanics, a versioned community-facing map that makes selected mechanics questions, their known/open boundaries, and criteria for progress explicit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论推导为主，辅以有限元数值验证，属混合研究；研究对象：均匀各向同性固体中含均匀膨胀本征应变的椭球及非椭球形夹杂
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了内部应变非均匀性与偏离椭球族的纯几何距离之间的非线性双边关系，并给出有限形状理论下系统收敛的上下界。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何借助AI在保持物理意义、数学严谨性与验证的前提下，定量刻画Eshelby猜想相关的稳定性问题。
证据与比较：摘要称该双边关系具有半阶Sobolev标度并捕捉形态长度尺度；对凸出、凹陷和颈缩夹杂给出的上下界与独立的基于位移的有限元计算一致。
papers.method_zh: 非线性双边不等式推导、半阶Sobolev标度分析、椭球减法的残余场预算及上下界构造，并与位移有限元计算对比。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称提出定量Eshelby稳定性理论及互补的有限形状理论，并记录了人主导、AI辅助的研究流程。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料参数、夹杂尺寸范围及定量误差；有限元对比细节与Open Problems in Mechanics的具体内容摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Pulse-by-pulse imaging of reversible, collective reshaping in laser-excited gold nanorods
papers.abstract: Nanomaterial properties are governed by atomic structure, and driving structural changes on demand could enable materials with programmable properties. Pulsed light is the most controllable route: wavelength, fluence, polarization and pulse timing can each be tuned to inject energy with nanometre and picosecond precision and mould atomic positions. Yet the spatiotemporal dynamics of these transformations have remained hidden, inferred only from before-and-after snapshots. Here we track gold nanorods in a transmission electron microscope under pulsed optical excitation, quantifying the structural transition frame by frame. The rods enter an unexpectedly dynamic regime: material redistributes within and between particles, twin boundaries nucleate and propagate, rods hundreds of nanometres apart reshape in concert, and individual rods almost vanish before recovering their original shape, indicating a structural memory. Driving and following these transformations with pulse-synchronized in situ electron microscopy could turn light-induced reshaping into a tool for setting structure, and consequently properties, on demand.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；原位脉冲光激发透射电镜逐帧成像；研究对象：脉冲光激发的金纳米棒
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金纳米棒在脉冲光激发下进入高度动态状态，发生可逆的集体重塑并表现出结构记忆。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：脉冲光诱导纳米材料结构变化过程中的时空动力学此前只能通过前后快照推断，如何逐帧追踪并量化这一转变？
证据与比较：在透射电镜中对金纳米棒进行脉冲光激发并逐帧量化结构转变，观察到材料在颗粒内和颗粒间重新分布、孪晶界形核与扩展、相距数百纳米的棒协同重塑，以及单根棒几乎消失后恢复原形。
papers.method_zh: 在透射电子显微镜下对金纳米棒施加脉冲光激发，采用脉冲同步原位电镜逐帧成像并量化结构转变。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称首次逐帧追踪脉冲光激发下金纳米棒的结构转变，揭示此前被前后快照掩盖的时空动力学。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明脉冲参数、样品环境、统计样本量及可逆性的定量判据；未提供全文，无法核实未在摘要中给出的条件与数字。

papers.title: Interplay of disorder and spin liquid physics in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet YbZn2GaO5
papers.abstract: YbZn2GaO5 has recently emerged as a structurally ideal triangular-lattice antiferromagnet and a promising candidate for hosting a U(1) Dirac quantum spin-liquid (QSL) ground state. However, signatures of broadened crystal electric field (CEF) excitations have raised questions about potential site disorder and its impact on the intrinsic spin dynamics. In this study, we employ 71Ga nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and muon spin relaxation (muSR) to microscopically probe both the structural and magnetic properties of YbZn2GaO5. NMR spectra reveal two inequivalent 71Ga sites and a broad distribution of quadrupolar frequencies, providing clear evidence of Ga$^{3+}$/Zn$^{2+}$ site mixing and local CEF randomness. The NMR spin-lattice relaxation rate exhibits, down to 1.3~K, a power-law temperature dependence, consistent with persisting spin dynamics below the exchange energy scale in a frustrated magnet. Complementary muSR measurements further show that the spin dynamics persist down to 30mK, with no signs of spin freezing. Together, these results establish that YbZn2GaO5 presents substantial structural disorder, while the persistence of dynamic spin fluctuations down to the lowest temperatures may indicate the survival of QSL-like excitations despite such disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；采用NMR和μSR两种微观测量手段。；研究对象：三角晶格反铁磁体YbZn2GaO5，候选U(1) Dirac量子自旋液体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YbZn2GaO5存在显著的Ga3+/Zn2+位点混合与局域晶体电场随机性，但动态自旋涨落仍持续至最低测量温度，可能表明QSL类激发在无序下存活。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：YbZn2GaO5中此前观测到的展宽晶体电场激发是否源于位点无序，以及该无序如何影响其本征自旋动力学和QSL基态候选性。
证据与比较：NMR谱显示两个不等价71Ga位点和宽的四极频率分布；NMR自旋-晶格弛豫率在低至1.3 K呈幂律温度依赖；μSR显示自旋动力学持续至30 mK且无自旋冻结迹象。
papers.method_zh: 71Ga核磁共振（NMR）测量谱与自旋-晶格弛豫率，以及μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）测量。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者在摘要中表述为：微观探针同时揭示结构无序与低温持续自旋动力学，可能指示QSL类激发在无序下存活。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明样品具体条件、无序定量程度及QSL基态的直接证据；结论基于NMR和μSR，未提供其他宏观或中子测量验证。

papers.title: Atomic Edge Resonators Flatten Phonon Bands in Biphenylene Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: We show that H--F edge complexes in biphenylene nanoribbons act as intrinsic atomic resonators, flattening low-frequency phonon branches. With increasing wave vector, flexural and twisting vibrations concentrate at the edges while motion of the carbon backbone is suppressed. Displacement profiles and edge-mass tuning identify a local-resonance mechanism, an atomic counterpart of a tuned mass damper. Combining machine-learned interatomic potentials, frozen-phonon calculations, and density-functional tight binding, we find that weakly dispersive modes contribute substantially to thermal band-gap narrowing. Zero-point motion shifts the calculated gap closure toward the experimentally observed ribbon widths. A hexagonal boron nitride substrate preserves the principal spectral features while reducing thermal renormalization. These results establish edge chemistry as a route to nearly flat phonon bands and connect a local atomic resonance to the electronic response of an entire nanoribbon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；摘要提及机器学习势、冻结声子与DFTB计算。；研究对象：含H–F边缘复合物的联苯烯纳米带，以及六方氮化硼衬底上的该体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 联苯烯纳米带的H–F边缘复合物可作为本征原子共振器，使低频声子支变平，并显著影响热带隙收窄。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：边缘化学如何通过局域原子共振改变联苯烯纳米带的低频声子色散，并进而影响其电子响应？
证据与比较：摘要报告：随波矢增大，弯曲与扭转振动集中于边缘而碳骨架运动被抑制；位移分布与边缘质量调谐指认局域共振机制；弱色散模式对热带隙收窄有实质贡献；零点运动使计算带隙闭合移向实验观测的纳米带宽度；hBN衬底保留主要谱特征并减弱热重正化。
papers.method_zh: 结合机器学习原子间势、冻结声子计算与密度泛函紧束缚方法。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称边缘化学可作为实现近平坦声子带的途径，并将局域原子共振与整个纳米带的电子响应联系起来。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体纳米带宽度、H–F覆盖度、温度范围及实验验证细节；未提供全文，无法核实计算参数与衬底相互作用的完整处理。

papers.title: Ultrafast laser-stimulated field emission from a metal: a non-equilibrium Green's functions approach
papers.abstract: Ultrafast laser-assisted field emission from metallic nanotips is a promising route for generating coherent electron pulses. However, existing theoretical models often neglect many-body strong correlation effects in the emitter's electronic structure and its response to the optical field. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework based on the non-equilibrium Green's function formalism to simulate the out-of-equilibrium electron dynamics across a strongly driven matter-vacuum interface, in a one-dimensional model. Treating the tip-vacuum coupling perturbatively, we find that the interplay between strong-field emission and multi-photon emission regimes can be described in terms of a filtering of the emitter's local density of occupied states through field-dressed vacuum propagators. By including electron-electron interactions via the second-Born approximation, we show that correlation-induced modifications in the electronic structure are directly transferred to the far-field spectrum. Finally, by self-consistently solving the Dyson equation at the interface, we uncover a dynamic back-action regime driven by the optical field, characterized by a periodic polarization of the emitter, which reshapes the far-field spectrum. This shows that the non-equilibrium Green's functions approach provides a versatile framework for exploring and analyzing field emission of correlated electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于非平衡格林函数形式构建一维模型；研究对象：金属纳米尖端的超快激光辅助场发射，一维模型体系
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强场发射与多光子发射的相互作用可描述为发射体占据态局域密度经场修饰真空传播子的过滤；电子关联对电子结构的修正直接传递到远场谱；自洽求解界面Dyson方程揭示光场驱动的动态反作用，表现为发射体周期性极化并重塑远场谱。

papers.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
papers.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. In addition to the analytical theory, we also present results in simple systems with flat bands with a nontrivial quantum metric and show that the biexcitonic spectrum differs strongly from that in the case without quantum geometry. Our theory paves the way for accurate quantitative calculations of biexciton spectra and excitonic many-body phases in modern condensed-matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；摘要提出通用激子-激子相互作用理论并给出平带计算结果；研究对象：任意晶体半导体体系中的激子，包括具有平带、非平庸量子度规和莫尔效应的体系

papers.main_content_zh:

papers.title: Graphene double quantum dot as a solid-state two-level system in the THz range
papers.abstract: Matter-based two-level quantum systems are fundamental building blocks of quantum technologies, underpinning applications in quantum computing, simulation, communication, and sensing. Today, most of these two-level quantum systems, including Rydberg atoms, trapped ions, superconducting circuits, molecules, and quantum dots, involve transition frequencies in microwave or optical domains. However, extending their transition frequency to the THz spectral range could provide numerous benefits, leveraging the unique properties of THz radiation. Here, we show that an hBN-encapsulated graphene double quantum dot realizes a two-level system with a transition frequency in the THz spectral range. Using low-temperature transport spectroscopy in the dark combined with modeling based on nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we demonstrate the formation of an artificial molecule, featuring bonding and antibonding states separated by an energy of up to 0.6 meV, corresponding to a resonance frequency of 0.145 THz. This approach provides direct access to important parameters of open double quantum dot systems, including tunneling rates, offering a practical alternative to conventional techniques such as photon-assisted tunneling, which are challenging to implement at THz frequencies. The realized 2D-material-based THz two-level system, compatible with direct on-chip integration, could serve as a key building block for future THz quantum technologies. Furthermore, by involving a single-electron transition, coupling these devices to a THz resonator could enable the exploration of ultra-strong light-matter interactions at the fundamental limit of a single transition coupled to a single cavity, beyond the reach of existing THz quantum systems based on collective transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合；低温输运谱结合非平衡格林函数建模；研究对象：hBN封装的石墨烯双量子点
papers.abstract_summary_zh: hBN封装石墨烯双量子点可实现跃迁频率在THz范围的两能级系统，形成键态与反键态分裂最高0.6 meV，对应0.145 THz。

papers.title: Equal-Spin local and nonlocal Andreev reflection in altermagnet/superconductor/altermagnet junction
papers.abstract: We investigated the equal-spin Andreev reflection phenomenon in an altermagnet/super\-conductor/altermagnet (AM/SC/AM) junction, focusing on the roles of the crystal orientation angle and the Néel vector. The crystal orientation angle in the AM effectively determines the spin-dependent transport channels for both electrons and holes, leading to orientation-dependent local and crossed Andreev reflection in the AM/SC/AM junction. We studied how and under what conditions this equal-spin Andreev reflection occurs. Rotating the Néel vector in the AM substantially increases spin-flip channels for both electrons and holes, giving rise to equal-spin Andreev reflection. When the Néel vector $θ=π/2$, the spin-dependent transmission channels for crystal orientations $α=0$ and $α=π/2$ are completely the same, the Andreev reflection coefficients remain different, reflecting the distinct roles of the Néel vector in spin space and the crystal orientation in real space. By tuning the crystal orientation angle and the Néel vector, orientation-dependent conventional and equal-spin Andreev reflection can be realized. This study reveals that Néel vector rotation is the direct cause of equal-spin Andreev reflection in AM/SC/AM junctions and provides a viable pathway for realizing spin-dependent superconducting transport phenomena in AM heterojunctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算，基于AM/SC/AM结的Andreev反射系数分析；研究对象：交变磁体/超导体/交变磁体（AM/SC/AM）结
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AM/SC/AM结中，旋转Néel矢量是等自旋Andreev反射的直接原因，晶向角与Néel矢量共同调控局域和交叉Andreev反射。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在AM/SC/AM结中，等自旋Andreev反射在何种条件下发生，以及晶向角和Néel矢量如何影响局域与交叉Andreev反射？
证据与比较：摘要给出：Néel矢量θ=π/2时，晶向α=0和α=π/2的自旋相关透射通道完全相同，但Andreev反射系数仍不同；通过调节晶向角和Néel矢量可实现取向依赖的常规与等自旋Andreev反射。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算AM/SC/AM结中的Andreev反射系数，分析晶向角和Néel矢量对自旋相关透射通道的影响。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称揭示了Néel矢量旋转是AM/SC/AM结中等自旋Andreev反射的直接原因，并提供实现自旋相关超导输运的可行路径。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料参数、计算模型细节、温度或界面条件；结论基于理论模型，未提供实验验证。

papers.title: Insights on the volume variation of LiCoxMn2-xO4 electrode upon cycling: a correlative operando XRD and XAS study
papers.abstract: Understanding volume changes in high-voltage spinel cathodes is essential for mitigating mechanical degradation and improving cycling stability. However, linking these changes to cation-specific redox processes remains challenging. Here, we combine operando X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to investigate the LiCoxMn2-xO4 spinel system, which exhibits a cubic structure and isotropic lattice response, in order to correlate the evolution of the local and long-range structure. Five compositions (x = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0) were synthesized and electrochemically characterized, with x = 0, 0.5, and 1.0 examined in detail under identical cycling conditions. XAS at the Mn and Co K-edges reveals distinct Mn4+/Mn3+ and Co4+/Co3+ redox processes, with Mn redox activity dominating below 4.7 V and Co redox triggered at higher potentials. Chemometric tools for XAS data analysis further resolve the evolution of local structure during cycling. Both XRD and XAS capture consistent trends in volume evolution, despite probing different structural length scales. Increasing Co content progressively decreases the overall volume change, from 5.0 % to 1.6 % by XAS and from 5.8 % to 2.1 % by XRD. These results demonstrate that Co substitution suppresses electrochemically induced structural strain and establish a direct link between cation-specific redox activity and volumetric evolution. The correlative operando XRD/XAS approach provides a framework to investigate newly designed low-strain, high-energy cathodes with improved cycling stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究；摘要明确为operando XRD与XAS联用测量。；研究对象：LiCoxMn2-xO4尖晶石正极（x=0、0.25、0.5、0.75、1.0）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Co取代可抑制电化学诱导的结构应变，使LiCoxMn2-xO4在循环中的体积变化随Co含量增加而减小。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何将高电压尖晶石正极循环中的体积变化与特定阳离子的氧化还原过程关联起来？
证据与比较：五种组成被合成并电化学表征，其中x=0、0.5、1.0在相同循环条件下详细研究；Mn、Co K边XAS显示Mn4+/Mn3+与Co4+/Co3+氧化还原，Mn活性主导4.7 V以下、Co活性在更高电位触发；XAS体积变化由5.0%降至1.6%，XRD由5.8%降至2.1%。
papers.method_zh: 联用operando X射线衍射与X射线吸收谱，并用化学计量学工具分析XAS数据。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称该关联operando XRD/XAS方法为研究新设计的低应变、高能量正极提供了框架。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体电压窗口、循环圈数、电流密度、温度及XRD/XAS体积变化差异的原因；未提供全文核实信息。

papers.title: Imbibition dynamics under dissolution-driven fluid thickening
papers.abstract: The imbibition of milk into a biscuit provides an example of a broader class of processes in which a liquid invades a porous material, dissolving components of the solid and thereby modifying its own rheology. This coupling between imbibition, dissolution, and evolving fluid rheology also occurs in food processing, filtration, and reactive porous media. While the resulting changes in fluid viscosity are known to affect imbibition, a quantitative description of how this evolving rheology determines the imbibition dynamics is still lacking. Here, we establish such a description for dissolution-driven fluid thickening. For a capillary tube in the well-mixed limit, we derive a generalized Washburn law showing that the evolving viscosity can be incorporated through a rescaled time given by the accumulated inverse viscosity. This predicts a collapse of the imbibition dynamics for different dissolution rates, which we confirm numerically using coupled free-surface and solute-transport simulations. When diffusion is slower, concentration and viscosity become spatially heterogeneous, resulting in a weaker retardation of the advancing liquid than predicted by the well-mixed theory. We then consider disordered porous media and quantify how dissolution-driven thickening and variations in pore geometry affect the dynamics. Our results extend the classical Washburn description to imbibition with evolving fluid properties and provide a quantitative basis for understanding fluid uptake when interactions with the solid progressively modify the rheology of the invading liquid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论推导结合数值模拟；摘要提及解析推导与耦合数值模拟；研究对象：毛细管及无序多孔介质中溶解驱动增稠的吸入过程
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于溶解驱动流体增稠，演化黏度可通过累积逆黏度定义的重新标度时间纳入广义Washburn定律，使不同溶解速率的吸入动力学坍缩；扩散较慢时空间非均匀性导致推进减弱。

研究问题：如何定量描述溶解导致流体黏度随时间演化时，吸入动力学如何被这一演化流变学所决定。

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称建立了溶解驱动流体增稠的定量描述，将经典Washburn描述扩展到流体性质演化的吸入过程。
papers.limitations_zh: 充分混合极限的解析结果适用于毛细管；慢扩散与无序多孔介质情形主要依赖数值模拟；摘要未明确说明具体材料参数、实验验证及定量适用范围。

papers.title: X-ray absorption spectroscopic studies of oxygen-deficient double perovskite oxide NdBaCo$_2$O$_{5+δ}$ ($δ\sim 0.65$)
papers.abstract: The degree of oxygen vacancy in A-site-doped layered double perovskite oxides can lead to anion vacancy ordering, which subsequently results in distinct superstructures. We have studied oxygen deficient double perovskite oxide, NdBaCo$2$O$_{5+δ}$ ($δ\sim$ 0.65), utilising X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy complemented by multiple scattering and first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT+U). The present results establish a direct correlation between oxygen-vacancy distribution, magnetic inhomogeneity, and charge transport in layered cobaltates. Our investigations on the Co K, Ba, and Nd $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ edges suggest that the near-edge spectra, based on the number and shape of the spectral features, indicate the value of $δ$ for the compound under study lies closer to 0.75. The analysis of the Ba $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ edge spectrum confirms the +2 oxidation state for Ba ions. The Co K-edge near-edge spectra suggest the possibility of oxygen vacancies arising at the basal sites in addition to the apical sites. This is counterintuitive to the common understanding that oxygen vacancies usually occur at the apical sites, i.e., in the lanthanide (Nd) layer in these compounds. Such a distribution of oxygen vacancies naturally explains the Griffith phase and the conduction mechanism of variable range hopping observed in the compound. The vacancy distribution, when at the optimum level, can also bring about easier oxygen ion mobility and a more sensitive and faster oxygen sensor. We believe that our results will help in tailoring oxygen-ion mobility and enhancing oxygen-sensing performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合；X射线吸收谱结合DFT+U计算；研究对象：缺氧双钙钛矿氧化物NdBaCo2O5+δ（δ约0.65）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧空位分布与磁不均匀性及电荷输运之间存在直接关联，且Co K边近边谱提示氧空位可能同时出现在基面位点而非仅顶端位点。
