papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称引入由机器人移动和感知实现的自主热力学循环，并展示自主系统导航环境时可涌现热力学循环。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体温度范围、材料参数、能量收集效率及实验可扩展性等适用条件。

papers.title: Epitaxial growth of WO3 on r-plane sapphire by hot-filament metal-oxide deposition using CO2 as a precursor
papers.abstract: The deposition of epitaxial films of WO3 by hot-filament metal-oxide deposition using CO2 as a precursor was demonstrated. The films were obtained at a low growth rate of 0.25 nm/min. The optical properties of the film were assessed by variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry, indicating transparency across the visible spectrum and high absorption above 3 eV.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；摘要描述薄膜沉积与光学表征；研究对象：r面蓝宝石衬底上外延生长的WO3薄膜
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用CO2为前驱体的热丝金属氧化物沉积法，在r面蓝宝石上实现了WO3外延薄膜生长。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否以CO2为前驱体，通过热丝金属氧化物沉积在r面蓝宝石上外延生长WO3薄膜并表征其光学性质。
证据与比较：摘要给出生长速率为0.25 nm/min；变角光谱椭偏仪结果显示薄膜在可见光谱范围透明，并在3 eV以上有高吸收。
papers.method_zh: 热丝金属氧化物沉积，以CO2为前驱体；变角光谱椭偏仪表征光学性质。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者在摘要中表述为首次演示以CO2为前驱体热丝金属氧化物沉积外延WO3薄膜。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明外延取向关系、薄膜厚度、衬底温度等具体条件；未提供全文核实信息。

papers.title: The role of density in shaping electron trapping in amorphous silicon nitride
papers.abstract: The electronic properties of amorphous silicon nitride vary with processing, which often changes stoichiometry and density together. Separating their contributions is essential to connect film structure with electron trapping. Across 499 stoichiometric configurations spanning 2.86-3.19g cm$^{-3}$, porosity controls the trapping mixture. Lower density increases accessible void fraction from 8.4 to 12.6%, expands internal surface and more than triples the supply of free three-coordinate Si precursors. Capture at pre-existing Si dangling bonds (K centres) rises from 9 to 29%, while induced-K and polaronic trapping decline. A neutral precursor fingerprint predicts the trapping mixture in held-out configurations and reproduces its density dependence. Local compensation controls K-centre activation, electronic competition selects capture, and bond strain predicts polaronic relaxation or induced-K formation. Routes involve distinct network volumes but retain their characteristic depths and relaxation energies across the density range. At fixed stoichiometry, density controls the trapping mixture through porosity and precursor availability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算，基于499种构型的原子尺度模拟；研究对象：化学计量比固定的非晶氮化硅，密度2.86-3.19 g cm^-3
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定化学计量比下，密度通过孔隙率和三配位Si前驱体供给控制非晶氮化硅的电子俘获类型组成。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在化学计量比不变时，密度如何独立影响非晶氮化硅中电子俘获的类型组成？
证据与比较：499种构型；密度升高使可及空隙率由8.4%降至12.6%区间变化、内部表面扩大、自由三配位Si前驱体供给增至三倍以上；K中心俘获占比由9%升至29%，诱导K与极化子俘获下降；中性前驱体指纹可预测留出构型的俘获组成。
papers.method_zh: 对499种不同密度的化学计量非晶氮化硅构型进行原子尺度计算，统计空隙率、内部表面、三配位Si前驱体与各类俘获占比，并用中性前驱体指纹做留出构型预测。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称在固定化学计量比下分离出密度对俘获组成的独立作用，并提出可预测俘获组成的中性前驱体指纹。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算泛函、温度与时间尺度、实验验证情况，也未说明该结论对其他化学计量比或沉积工艺的适用性。

papers.title: Probing $L_z$ Orbital Angular Momentum via Wavefunction-Interference-Induced Charge Order
papers.abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) characterization is central to understanding quantum materials such as valley Hall and Rashba systems and, through its connection to Berry curvature, provides key insight into band topology. Conventional OAM detection via photoemission dichroism, however, is susceptible to interference artifacts and is largely restricted to occupied states. Here, we demonstrate a real-space approach to map the $L_z$ OAM character using scanning tunneling microscopy in triangular atomic monolayers. Unlike photoemission, this method exploits interference effects arising from the $L_z$ orbital phase and the Bloch phase associated with neighboring atoms. This shifts the local density of states (LDOS) maxima to distinct Wyckoff positions between atoms, encoding $L_z$ information into characteristic real-space LDOS patterns. We exemplify this approach in 2D quantum materials with contrasting $L_z$ sequences, namely Tl/Si(111) and In/SiC(0001) monolayers, identifying $L_z$-dependent LDOS accumulation associated with distinct topological phases in both systems. Our results establish $L_z$-dependent charge localization as a proxy to atomic obstruction for energetically isolated states in triangular lattices, including transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究，基于扫描隧道显微镜的实空间测量。；研究对象：Tl/Si(111)和In/SiC(0001)三角原子单层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用波函数干涉诱导的电荷有序，在实空间映射Lz轨道角动量，并在两种二维量子材料中识别出与不同拓扑相相关的Lz依赖的局域态密度积累。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何避免传统光电子二色性探测轨道角动量时易受干涉伪影影响且局限于占据态的缺点，实现Lz轨道角动量的实空间探测？
证据与比较：摘要显示，在Tl/Si(111)和In/SiC(0001)单层中观测到Lz依赖的局域态密度积累，并关联到不同的拓扑相；但未提供具体测量数值、比较细节或控制变量。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜实空间成像，利用Lz轨道相位与相邻原子Bloch相位干涉导致的局域态密度极大值位移。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称展示了一种实空间方法映射Lz轨道角动量，不同于光电子二色性，并建立Lz依赖的电荷局域化作为三角晶格中能量孤立态的原子阻塞代理。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件；方法可能限于三角晶格中能量孤立的态，包括过渡金属二硫化物；未提供定量证据或样品细节。

papers.title: Achieving room temperature plasticity in TiO2 ceramics by flash processing
papers.abstract: Ceramics are indispensable materials for modern engineering and high-technology applications. However, the intrinsic brittleness at room temperature can cause catastrophic failure and severely limit their widespread applications. Here, we report a flash processing (FP) method based on the coupling of electric and thermal fields to significantly improve the room-temperature plasticity of TiO2 ceramics with a large plastic compressive strain of 15.4% during micropillar compression. This large room-temperature plasticity is attributed to the proliferation of stacking faults and twin boundaries during the loading process, which may be assisted by the high concentration of oxygen vacancies introduced by the FP method. Our findings suggest that FP can be a simple and effective method for achieving improved room-temperature plasticity of ceramic materials through defect engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究；基于微柱压缩测试与微观缺陷表征；研究对象：TiO2陶瓷
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 闪烧处理可显著提升TiO2陶瓷室温塑性，微柱压缩塑性应变达15.4%。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何改善陶瓷在室温下的本征脆性，从而避免灾难性失效并拓展其应用？
证据与比较：微柱压缩测试显示室温塑性压缩应变达15.4%；摘要将塑性归因于加载过程中层错和孪晶界的增殖，并推测与闪烧引入的高浓度氧空位有关。
papers.method_zh: 基于电场与热场耦合的闪烧处理方法，结合微柱压缩测试。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称闪烧可作为一种简单有效的方法，通过缺陷工程改善陶瓷材料的室温塑性。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明闪烧的具体参数、氧空位浓度的定量证据及该方法的普适性；相关机制为推测性表述。

papers.title: Multipolar fluctuations in localized $4f^2$-electron systems from dynamical mean-field theory: application to $\mathrm{PrCdNi}_4$
papers.abstract: Multipolar-fluctuation analysis based on density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory is extended from $4f^1$- to $4f^2$-electron systems. Two methodological developments are presented. First, many-particle states are constructed within the $j$-$j$ coupling scheme in the $j=5/2$ subspace, so as to reproduce the crystalline-electric-field splitting of the $4f^2$ Hund's-rule ground-state multiplet. Second, multipolar susceptibilities and interactions between $4f^2$ multiplets are derived through a mapping from single-particle to many-particle bases. We apply this framework to PrCdNi$_4$, which has a non-Kramers $Γ_3$ doublet ground state, and propose a $(3z^2-r^2)$-type antiferroquadrupolar order at $\boldsymbol{q}=(2π,π,0)$ driven by the competition between nearest- and fourth-nearest-neighbor interactions. The formalism developed here is applicable to general $4f^n$-electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算，基于DFT+DMFT的理论计算；研究对象：局域4f²电子体系，具体为PrCdNi₄
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PrCdNi₄中提出由最近邻与第四近邻相互作用竞争驱动的(3z²-r²)型反铁四极序，波矢为q=(2π,π,0)。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何将基于DFT+DMFT的多极涨落分析从4f¹电子体系推广到4f²电子体系，并应用于具有非Kramers Γ₃双重态基态的PrCdNi₄。
证据与比较：摘要报告了两项方法学发展：在j=5/2子空间用j-j耦合方案构造多粒子态以重现4f² Hund规则基态多重态的晶体电场劈裂；通过单粒子到多粒子基的映射导出多极磁化率与4f²多重态间相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论，在j-j耦合方案的j=5/2子空间构造多粒子态，并通过基变换映射导出多极磁化率和相互作用。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称将多极涨落分析从4f¹推广到4f²体系，并提出两项方法学发展，且该形式适用于一般4f^n电子体系。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明计算的具体参数、温度或材料样品条件；所提出的反铁四极序为理论预测，摘要未提供实验验证信息。

papers.title: Demonstration of ultrafast coherent sub-picosecond magnon pulses
papers.abstract: Ultrafast magnonics explores routes towards energy-efficient information processing by replacing electrons with pulses of terahertz magnons. The critical, but so far elusive, requirement on the magnon pulses is the combination of high-speed and a long-range propagation while maintaining a well-defined narrow waveform of the pulses. Here, we demonstrate the launching of 0.4-picosecond magnon pulses in the altermagnetic insulator $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ (hematite) using broadband terahertz spin-orbit torques by an adjacent platinum layer. Phase-resolved terahertz transmission reveals that these sub-picosecond pulses travel ballistically, coherently and non-dispersively at a constant velocity of 23 nm/ps, transport angular momentum and retain their temporal waveform shape over 160 nm, with an inferred relaxation length in hundreds of nanometers or more. Beyond establishing $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ as an optimal platform for ultrafast magnonics, our technique introduces a high-resolution, tabletop method to directly extract dispersion relations up to high wavevectors, and explore ultrafast magnon dynamics in altermagnets and other magnetic materials with teraherz-range dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；用太赫兹透射测量磁振子脉冲；研究对象：交替磁绝缘体α-Fe₂O₃（赤铁矿）及相邻铂层体系
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在α-Fe₂O₃中通过铂层宽带太赫兹自旋轨道力矩激发0.4皮秒磁振子脉冲，该脉冲以23 nm/ps速度弹道式、相干、无色散传播，保持波形超过160 nm。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何同时实现磁振子脉冲的高速、长程传播并保持窄而确定的波形？
证据与比较：相位分辨太赫兹透射显示脉冲以23 nm/ps恒速传播，保持时间波形超过160 nm，推断弛豫长度为数百纳米或更长；摘要未提供具体误差或统计。
papers.method_zh: 利用相邻铂层产生的宽带太赫兹自旋轨道力矩激发，并通过相位分辨太赫兹透射测量。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称建立了α-Fe₂O₃作为超快磁振子学最优平台，并引入高分辨率桌面方法直接提取高波矢色散关系。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明样品温度、铂层厚度等条件；推断的弛豫长度未给出具体数值；未提供全文验证。

papers.title: Nonlinearity management of matter-wave vector solitons of Bose-Einstein condensates in two dimensions
papers.abstract: The evolution of matter-wave vector solitons in two dimensions under nonlinearity management is studied. The averaged over strong and rapid modulations in time of the inter-species interactions vector Gross-Pitaevskii equation is derived. The averaging gives the appearance of the effective nonlinear quantum pressure depending on the population of the other component. Using this system of equations, the dynamical stabilization of the two-dimensional vector matter-wave solitons under the management of the mean-field nonlinearity is investigated. It is shown that the nonlinear quantum pressure arrests the collapse in the averaged system, giving rise to stable vector solitons. Full numerical simulations of the original, time-dependent system of Gross-Pitaevskii equations confirm that the management strongly prolongs the lifetime of these solitons compared to the unmanaged case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算，基于Gross-Pitaevskii方程推导与数值模拟；研究对象：二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的物质波矢量孤子
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在种间相互作用快速调制下，平均化产生的有效非线性量子压力可阻止坍缩，形成稳定的二维矢量物质波孤子，并显著延长其寿命。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何通过非线性管理实现二维物质波矢量孤子的动力学稳定化，避免坍缩。
证据与比较：推导了强快速时间调制下的平均矢量Gross-Pitaevskii方程，发现有效非线性量子压力依赖于另一组分的布居数；对原始含时方程的全数值模拟表明，与未管理情形相比，管理显著延长孤子寿命。
papers.method_zh: 对种间相互作用进行强快速时间调制，推导平均矢量Gross-Pitaevskii方程，并进行全数值模拟。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称平均化产生依赖于另一组分布居数的有效非线性量子压力，并由此实现二维矢量孤子的动力学稳定化。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体参数范围、调制频率条件及定量寿命延长倍数；未提供实验验证信息。

papers.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
papers.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；摘要提及对晶体进行磁光性质研究；研究对象：氯取代的范德华层状半导体CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ（x=56%）及纯CrSBr晶体
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使氯取代水平达x=56%，CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ仍表现出与纯CrSBr晶体定性相同的清晰磁光耦合，相关参数随取代水平平滑变化。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：氯取代如何影响范德华层状半导体CrSBr的磁光性质，以及取代是否破坏其磁光耦合。
证据与比较：摘要报告在x=56%取代水平下仍观察到与纯CrSBr晶体定性相同的清晰磁光耦合，且相关参数值在不同取代水平间平滑变化。
papers.method_zh: 对CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ进行系统性磁光性质研究，并与纯CrSBr晶体比较。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称该研究显示氯取代可提供有前景的可调性，且高取代水平下磁光耦合仍保持。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体测量条件、取代水平范围、参数细节及适用限制；仅基于标题和摘要，未读全文。

papers.title: Laser fragmentation in liquid - constructing a generic reaction map
papers.abstract: Excitation of absorbing colloids in liquid by pulsed laser irradiation creates highly non-equilibrium states of matter that relax via defined pathways of thermal and non-thermal dissipation channels. The structural fingerprint of these channels can be probed by ultrafast {\it in situ} x-ray scattering methods and classified as a function of temporal delay of excitation excitation density, or specifically laser fluence. We study the example of photo-excitation of a gold colloid by picosecond laser pulses at the interband absorption band at 400 nm in water. By quantifying lattice temperature, crystalline fraction, particle sizes and the structural response of the water around the nanoparticles a reaction map is constructed that allows to pinpoint heating, particle melting, water bubble formation and finally particle fragmentation to form nanoclusters of predominant sizes of < 3 nm for applications in theranostics, photonics or catalysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；摘要描述超快原位X射线散射探测激光激发胶体。；研究对象：水中金胶体，400 nm皮秒激光脉冲激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过量化晶格温度、晶态分数、粒径及水结构响应，构建反应图，可定位加热、颗粒熔化、水泡形成及碎裂为<3 nm纳米团簇。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何将激光激发吸收性胶体产生的非平衡弛豫路径，按时间延迟或激光通量分类并构建通用反应图。
证据与比较：摘要称用超快原位X射线散射探测热与非热耗散通道的结构指纹，并量化晶格温度、晶态分数、粒径和纳米颗粒周围水的结构响应。
papers.method_zh: 皮秒激光脉冲在400 nm激发水中金胶体，结合超快原位X射线散射。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称构建了反应图，可定位加热、颗粒熔化、水泡形成及碎裂为<3 nm纳米团簇。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件、定量范围及反应图通用性验证；未提供全文核实信息。

papers.title: From band reconstruction to Bogoliubov dispersion: How dz2-band enhances iron-based superconductivity
papers.abstract: Conventional understanding of iron-based superconductivity is usually established based on electronic bands at the Fermi level, leaving deeper bands overlooked as potential factor. Here, we expand this view by demonstrating that a deep-lying dz2 band below the Fermi level can be employed to enhance the superconducting paring strength. By using scanning tunneling microscope to mechanically change the crystal lattice of an iron-based superconductor, we observe an upward shift of the deep-lying dz2 band related feature, leading to hybridization with the primary superconducting bands at the Fermi level. We visualize the novel evidence of this band hybridization and resulting enhanced superconducting gap through quasiparticle interference imaging, providing conclusive evidence that engineering such correlations between deep and pairing-active bands is a potent mechanism for amplifying the superconducting gap. This work refines the conventional view of pairing-relevant electronic structures and establishes band hybridization as an effective way to optimize superconducting materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究，基于扫描隧道显微镜测量。；研究对象：铁基超导体中费米能级以下的深层dz2能带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机械改变晶格可使深层dz2能带上移并与费米能级处主要超导能带杂化，从而增强超导配对强度。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：深层dz2能带能否通过晶格调控与费米能级处超导能带杂化，进而增强铁基超导配对强度？
证据与比较：扫描隧道显微镜机械改变晶格后，观察到深层dz2能带相关特征上移，并通过准粒子干涉成像可视化能带杂化及增强的超导能隙。
papers.method_zh: 使用扫描隧道显微镜机械改变铁基超导体晶格，并进行准粒子干涉成像。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称将深层dz2能带作为增强超导配对强度的因素，并建立能带杂化作为优化超导材料的有效途径。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料、实验条件、定量增强幅度及适用温度范围。

papers.title: Generation, Accumulation, and Utilization of Data in the Automatically Controlled End-Station of a Soft X-ray Beamline
papers.abstract: AI is rapidly transforming materials exploration, yet reliable AI-assisted research depends on experimental data that retains their context, provenance, and machine-readable structure. High-throughput synchrotron measurements therefore require more than automated data acquisition: data generation, accumulation, and utilization must be connected within a continuous workflow. Here, we present a data-centric research framework that integrates the PIONEER system, the OMNES, and ML analysis. The PIONEER system automates sample handling, vacuum transfer, and scanning XAS at the BL08U soft X-ray beamline of NanoTerasu, systematically generating large volumes of spatially resolved spectral data. Measurement and analysis files are stored in the cloud-based ARIM-mdx data system, while OMNES manages metadata describing samples, preparation procedures, measurement conditions, instrument settings, data locations, and analysis histories. Tabular and JavaScript Object Notation formats are used according to the metadata structure, with numerical values stored separately from units to facilitate machine processing. OMNES organizes these records based on causal relationships among experimental and analytical processes, linking samples, measurements, raw data, processed data, and analysis results through a relational data model and visualizing their relationships as a graph. This causality-based organization preserves experimental and analytical provenance and clarifies how each result was derived from the preceding processes and data. The accumulated spectra can subsequently be processed using ML methods, including dimensionality reduction and materials classification, and the resulting data can be registered back into OMNES. Previously reported ML analysis of BN XAS spectra is presented as an example of the analytical workflow that can be applied to data acquired at the beamline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：方法/框架开发，基于同步辐射实验与数据系统集成；研究对象：NanoTerasu BL08U软X射线光束线自动控制终端站及BN XAS光谱数据
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个以数据为中心的研究框架，将PIONEER自动测量系统、OMNES元数据管理系统与机器学习分析整合，实现同步辐射数据从生成、积累到利用的连续工作流。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何将高通量同步辐射测量中的数据生成、积累和利用连接为连续工作流，以保留实验数据的上下文、来源和机器可读结构？
证据与比较：摘要描述PIONEER在BL08U光束线自动执行样品处理、真空转移和扫描XAS，生成空间分辨光谱数据；测量与分析文件存入ARIM-mdx云数据系统；OMNES管理样品、制备、测量条件、仪器设置、数据位置和分析历史等元数据，并以表格和JSON格式存储，数值与单位分离；OMNES基于因果关系组织记录并可视化为图；已报道的BN XAS光谱ML分析作为示例。
papers.method_zh: 集成PIONEER自动样品处理与扫描XAS系统、OMNES元数据管理系统、ARIM-mdx云数据系统，以及包括降维和材料分类的机器学习方法。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称该框架将数据生成、积累和利用连接为连续工作流，并通过基于因果关系的元数据组织保留实验和分析来源。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明框架的适用条件、性能限制或普适性；BN XAS光谱ML分析为已报道示例，摘要未提供其具体细节。

papers.title: Quantum annealing of the random transverse-field Ising model in one, two, and three dimensions
papers.abstract: Quantum annealing must be sufficiently slow to prevent defect formation. We study this problem in the random transverse-field Ising model via the adiabatic theorem to obtain the limiting rate at which defect formation can be avoided. Our approach based on the strong-disorder renormalization group (SDRG) technique views the annealing process as a gradual aggregation of strongly coupled clusters, giving access to the elementary events of error formation. We present a scaling theory of the statistics of these events in general dimensions and confront it to an extensive numerical analysis carried out in one, two, and three dimensions by an efficient implementation of the SDRG method. This approach is also validated by exact diagonalization in one dimension by means of the free-fermion technique. Our results consistently show a logarithmically slow decrease of the error density with the annealing time, characterized by the dimension-dependent critical exponents of the corresponding infinite-disorder fixed point of the model. Furthermore, we provide a map of individual events of potential defect formation in the excitation energy - control parameter plane, which may help in the design of optimal annealing paths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论结合大规模数值计算，含一维精确对角化验证。；研究对象：一、二、三维随机横场Ising模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 误差密度随退火时间呈对数级缓慢下降，其标度由该模型无限无序不动点的维度依赖临界指数决定。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在随机横场Ising模型中，如何基于绝热定理确定避免缺陷形成所需的极限退火速率及其统计规律？
证据与比较：通过强无序重整化群给出事件统计的标度理论，并在1、2、3维进行大规模数值分析；一维结果由自由费米子精确对角化验证；误差密度随退火时间对数下降，标度由维度依赖临界指数刻画。
papers.method_zh: 基于强无序重整化群（SDRG）的退火过程团簇聚集图像，结合一维自由费米子精确对角化验证。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称将退火视为强耦合团簇逐步聚集，从而获得误差形成的基本事件，并给出一般维度的统计标度理论及缺陷事件在激发能-控制参数平面的映射。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体参数范围、有限尺寸效应及三维数值的收敛性；未提供退火路径优化的定量验证。

papers.title: Magnonic cavity-enhanced quantum magnetometry with nitrogen-vacancy centre ensembles
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre ensembles are leading room-temperature magnetometers, but their sensitivity is usually extracted from a single resonance and relies on external microwave and bias-field hardware. This work proposes a chip-scale NV magnetometer built around a one-dimensional YIG/CoFeB magnonic crystal, in which a single structural defect forms a passive magnonic cavity and integrated permanent magnets supply the bias field. Micromagnetic simulations show a defect-localised spin-wave mode at 2.910 GHz inside the 2.5-3.0 GHz magnonic band gap, 40 MHz from the NV zero-field splitting, with a band structure that matches an independent plane-wave calculation. A Tavis-Cummings/Lindblad model in which the microwave reaches the NV ensemble through this mode predicts a hyperfine-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance spectrum that is strong only within the mode linewidth, and a dispersive homodyne response with one steep edge per $^{14}$N hyperfine line. The master-equation solutions agree with the closed-form homodyne steady state ($R^2 > 0.9999$) and with an approximate analytic ODMR theory (peak positions within 0.012 MHz). For a critically coupled readout with room-temperature electronics, combining the three edges gives a projected sensitivity of 93 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$, a $\sqrt{3}$-fold gain over the best single edge. Mapping the sensitivity against the NV-magnon coupling reveals an optimum near $g_{\rm ens}/2π\approx 0.2$-$0.4$ MHz, where it reaches 72 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for a 0.64 MHz spin linewidth and 19 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for 0.17 MHz, with thermal limits of 6.6 and 1.7 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$. The antenna-mode coupling, the NV-magnon coupling and the spin linewidth are therefore the main design levers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论，基于微磁模拟与主方程模型；研究对象：一维YIG/CoFeB磁振子晶体与NV色心系综耦合的芯片级磁强计
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YIG/CoFeB磁振子晶体中引入单个结构缺陷形成无源磁振子腔，其局域自旋波模式可耦合NV系综，预测多边缘色散读出可提升灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何利用磁振子晶体缺陷腔替代外部微波与偏置场硬件，并提升NV系综磁强计的灵敏度？
证据与比较：微磁模拟显示2.910 GHz缺陷局域模式位于2.5-3.0 GHz带隙内，距NV零场分裂40 MHz，能带与平面波计算一致；主方程解与闭式零差稳态R²>0.9999、ODMR峰位差<0.012 MHz；三边缘组合预测93 pT/√Hz，最优耦合下72和19 pT/√Hz，热极限6.6和1.7 pT/√Hz。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟、平面波能带计算、Tavis-Cummings/Lindblad主方程与零差稳态解析模型。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出芯片级NV磁强计，用一维YIG/CoFeB磁振子晶体单缺陷形成无源腔并集成永磁偏置，通过多边缘色散读出提升灵敏度。
papers.limitations_zh: 结果为微磁模拟与理论预测，未提供实验验证；灵敏度基于室温电子学临界耦合读出假设；摘要未明确样品制备条件与器件实际噪声。

papers.title: Strain-engineered long-distance supercurrent in an altermagnetic CrSb based-Josephson junction
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic materials, characterized by vanishing net magnetization and momentum-dependent spin splitting, provide a unique platform for realizing unconventional superconducting states without the detrimental stray fields. Here, we demonstrate long-distance Josephson supercurrent transport through epitaxial thin films of the strained altermagnet CrSb. We observe a dissipationless supercurrent across a lateral spacer distance of 150 nm in a CrSb-based Josephson junction, exceeding the conventional spin-singlet coherence length by nearly two orders of magnitude. This supercurrent is further accompanied by a well-defined magnetic-field-induced quantum interference pattern, providing direct evidence for genuine Josephson coupling. Our results reveal altermagnets as a promising route toward generating long-distance supercurrents without macroscopic magnetic stray fields, opening new opportunities for superconducting spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；摘要描述外延薄膜器件输运测量；研究对象：应变交替磁体CrSb外延薄膜及其横向约瑟夫森结
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变交替磁体CrSb基约瑟夫森结中观察到跨越150 nm的远距离无耗散超电流，并伴随磁场诱导的量子干涉图样。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否在无宏观杂散场的交替磁体CrSb中实现超越常规自旋单态相干长度的远距离约瑟夫森超电流输运。
证据与比较：摘要报告横向间隔150 nm处存在无耗散超电流，该距离比常规自旋单态相干长度超出近两个数量级，并观察到明确的磁场诱导量子干涉图样。
papers.method_zh: 基于应变交替磁体CrSb外延薄膜制备横向约瑟夫森结，进行超电流输运测量并观测磁场诱导量子干涉。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称交替磁体可作为无需宏观磁杂散场即可产生远距离超电流的途径，为超导自旋电子学应用提供新机会。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明应变条件、温度、结势垒材料、界面质量及可重复性；RSS片段可能截断，未读全文。

papers.title: Data-Driven Variable-Exponent Analysis for Photoemission Yield Spectroscopy: An Autonomous Self-Diagnosing Framework Based on Integrated Residual Metrics
papers.abstract: Photoemission yield spectroscopy (PYS) is widely used for evaluating the electronic states of materials. As automated materials discovery advances, unsupervised extraction of physical information from ambient-air PYS data becomes important. Conventional fixed-exponent analyses and logarithmic transformations suffer from heteroscedasticity, which destabilizes estimation in low-signal regions. To address this, we propose a data-driven analysis framework based on the 1/n-Scan method, which operates directly in the original signal space, removing the geometric bias inherent in log-transform approaches. We further integrate a self-diagnostic quality-evaluation system that quantifies estimation uncertainty with Akaike weights, together with independent residual metrics--the normalized mean absolute error (NMAE), the RMSE-to-MAE ratio (RMR), the Durbin-Watson (DW) statistic, and a macroscopic metric ($ΔR^2$)--that distinguish hardware-related data degradation from a physical-model mismatch. Applying the framework to differently doped Si and a polycrystalline Au reference in air, we demonstrate autonomous detection, without assumptions on the emission mechanism, of the breakdown of the single-component approximation in heavily doped p-type Si, arising from the overlap of two emission components with different thresholds, as a statistical anomaly--a decrease in DW below its critical value with an auxiliary increase in $ΔR^2$, despite sound NMAE and RMR--independently confirmed by a two-component fit ($Δ$AIC $\approx$ 57, DW recovering from 0.8 to 2.0). For heavily doped n-type Si, the gradual surface evolution was classified as a change within the single-component description. This framework provides a robust, self-diagnosing analysis engine for closed-loop autonomous materials exploration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析框架开发，基于PYS数据验证；研究对象：不同掺杂类型的Si及多晶Au参考样品，在空气中测量的光电子产额谱
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于1/n-Scan的数据驱动变指数分析框架，结合自诊断质量评估，可在无发射机制假设下自主检测单组分近似失效，并区分硬件退化与物理模型失配。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何从环境空气PYS数据中无监督地提取物理信息，并稳定估计低信号区域，同时自主诊断数据质量与模型失配？
证据与比较：重掺p型Si中DW低于临界值且ΔR²辅助增加，NMAE和RMR正常，双组分拟合ΔAIC≈57，DW从0.8恢复至2.0；重掺n型Si表面演化被归类为单组分描述内变化。
papers.method_zh: 基于1/n-Scan方法在原始信号空间直接操作，结合Akaike权重及NMAE、RMR、DW统计量和ΔR²等残差指标进行自诊断质量评估。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称提出数据驱动变指数分析框架，去除对数变换的几何偏差，并集成自诊断系统以区分硬件退化与物理模型失配。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件；仅涉及Si和Au样品，未提供其他材料或环境条件的验证；未讨论框架在更广泛PYS数据上的普适性。

papers.title: Displacement-Field-Induced Ionization of Defect States in High-Quality hBN
papers.abstract: Encapsulation of two-dimensional (2D) materials with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is widely used to fabricate ultraclean van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures for optoelectronic and quantum transport studies. These devices are often operated under strong out-of-plane displacement fields that tune the electronic properties of the active 2D material, while the surrounding hBN is typically assumed to remain electronically inert. This assumption, however, neglects defect states that are present even in high-quality hBN crystals. Here, we probe their response to the applied displacement field using monolayer graphene encapsulated between hBN crystals as a sensitive charge sensor. Increasing the displacement field induces notable charge transfer between graphene and hBN, producing additional electron doping of 10-20x10^9 cm^(-2) even at the moderate displacement field (~0.5 V nm^(-1)), while simultaneously increasing carrier-density inhomogeneity of the graphene layer. Both effects are consistent with ionization of defect states within the hBN bandgap, with the bulk density ~1-7x10^(-5) nm^(-3) varying across different hBN crystals. Our results show that displacement-field-induced defect ionization in hBN can modify the electronic response of vdW heterostructures, with direct implications for device design and interpretation of experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究；以石墨烯为电荷传感器探测hBN缺陷态响应。；研究对象：高质量六方氮化硼（hBN）晶体及其封装单层石墨烯的范德华异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位移场可电离hBN带隙中的缺陷态，导致石墨烯与hBN间显著电荷转移并增加石墨烯载流子密度不均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：高质量hBN在强垂直位移场下是否保持电子惰性，其缺陷态如何响应位移场并影响异质结电子性质。
证据与比较：在约0.5 V nm⁻¹中等位移场下，石墨烯额外电子掺杂达10–20×10⁹ cm⁻²，同时载流子密度不均匀性增加；不同hBN晶体的缺陷体密度为1–7×10⁻⁵ nm⁻³。
papers.method_zh: 以hBN封装的单层石墨烯作为灵敏电荷传感器，施加垂直位移场并测量石墨烯电荷转移与载流子密度不均匀性。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称揭示了位移场诱导hBN缺陷态电离，挑战了hBN在异质结中电子惰性的通常假设。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明温度、hBN厚度、缺陷类型及器件制备细节；结论基于特定石墨烯传感器体系，普适性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Multifunctionality in Janus CrMCN4 (M = Si/Ge) Monolayers: Valleytronic Physics, Piezoelectric Response, and Photocatalytic Potential
papers.abstract: Two dimensional Janus semiconductors integrating spin-valley coupling, piezoelectricity, and tunable optical responses offer a platform for multifunctional nanodevices. Here, first-principles calculations reveal complementary composition and strain effects in CrSiCN4 and CrGeCN4 monolayers. Both are found to be nonmagnetic direct-gap semiconductors, with gaps of 1.23 and 1.09 eV using the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof functional including spin-orbit coupling, respectively. HSE06 hybrid-functional calculations retain the direct-gap character, yielding gaps of 1.46 eV for CrSiCN4 and 1.19 eV for CrGeCN4. Opposite out-of-plane spin character and Berry curvature emerge at K and K'. Biaxial strain reduces the respective gaps from 1.59 to 0.86 eV and 1.44 to 0.63 eV, drives direct-to-indirect transitions, and redshifts absorption while preserving valley spin contrast. CrGeCN4 exhibits larger in-plane piezoelectric response, whereas CrSiCN4 exhibits larger out-of-plane magnitude. Band-edge alignment satisfies the oxygen evolution reaction requirement but provides insufficient driving force for the hydrogen evolution reaction, motivating further strain-induced band-edge modulation toward overall water splitting. These results establish composition and strain as complementary controls for tailoring Cr-based Janus monolayers for valleytronic, optoelectronic, electromechanical, and photocatalytic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；基于第一性原理与HSE06杂化泛函计算；研究对象：Janus CrMCN4（M = Si/Ge）单层
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrSiCN4与CrGeCN4单层是非磁性直接带隙半导体，具有相反的自旋谷特征与Berry曲率，组分和双轴应变可互补调控其带隙、压电响应与光吸收。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何通过组分选择与双轴应变，在Cr基Janus单层中协同调控谷电子学、压电、光电及光催化性能。
证据与比较：PBE+SOC带隙为1.23和1.09 eV，HSE06为1.46和1.19 eV；K与K'处出现相反面外自旋特征和Berry曲率；双轴应变使带隙分别从1.59降至0.86 eV、从1.44降至0.63 eV，并驱动直接-间接转变、红移吸收；CrGeCN4面内压电响应更大，CrSiCN4面外更大；带边满足析氧反应要求但不满足析氢反应驱动力。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算，采用PBE泛函并包含自旋轨道耦合，辅以HSE06杂化泛函，施加双轴应变。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称组分与应变可作为互补调控手段，用于定制Cr基Janus单层的谷电子学、光电、机电和光催化应用。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体应变范围、压电系数数值、光催化效率及实验可行性；析氢反应驱动力不足，需进一步应变调控带边。

papers.title: A hinged honeycomb with zero bulk modulus retaining more than four-fifths of its constituent's shear modulus
papers.abstract: A Poisson's ratio near -1 indicates only that the bulk modulus is small compared with the shear modulus. In solid-void structures, the mechanism that frees the dilation usually weakens the resistance to shear as well, resulting in both moduli becoming small. In two-dimensional linear elasticity, we demonstrate that this loss is not inevitable. We consider a honeycomb of regular hexagonal blocks of a single incompressible isotropic elastic solid, joined along their whole edges by ideal interfaces that allow relative sliding along a direction inclined to the edge normal. Collective infinitesimal block rotations produce an exact dilational mechanism, so the effective bulk modulus vanishes, while sixfold symmetry ensures isotropy. The interfaces, however, transmit traction along their whole length. In a solid-void realization, each interface is replaced with fine solid plates separated by void, which bend easily yet retain their capacity to transmit axial force. Such dilational materials, which expand or contract freely while resisting every change of shape, could serve as interlayers that accommodate thermal or swelling mismatch while still transmitting shear, and as components in stents and deployable structures that change size without changing shape. An explicit, statically admissible stress field and the complementary energy principle yield a rigorous lower bound on the retained shear modulus, and a limiting argument transfers this bound to the solid-void mixtures. The honeycomb retains more than four-fifths of its constituent's shear modulus at zero bulk modulus: the supremum S of the normalized shear modulus of such mixtures satisfies S > 0.8528 > 4/5, exceeding the value attained by Milton's construction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论，基于二维线弹性分析和变分原理；研究对象：由规则六边形块体通过可滑动界面连接而成的蜂窝结构
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该蜂窝结构在零体积模量下仍保留超过其组分材料剪切模量五分之四的剪切模量，归一化剪切模量的上确界S > 0.8528 > 4/5。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在二维线性弹性固体-空隙结构中，能否在实现零体积模量的同时避免剪切模量的大幅损失？
证据与比较：通过显式静力许可应力场和互补能量原理，得到保留剪切模量的严格下界；极限论证将该下界推广到固体-空隙混合物；给出S > 0.8528 > 4/5，并称超过Milton构造达到的值。
papers.method_zh: 二维线性弹性理论分析；构造显式静力许可应力场；应用互补能量原理导出下界；极限论证推广至固体-空隙实现。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称证明这种损失并非不可避免，并构造出零体积模量下保留超过五分之四剪切模量的蜂窝结构，其归一化剪切模量上确界超过Milton构造。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料参数、样品制备条件、实验验证或三维推广；结果基于二维线弹性理论模型和理想界面假设。

papers.title: High Efficiency in Large Supercurrent Rectification with Superconducting Coil
papers.abstract: Superconducting diodes (SDs) are devices that rectify supercurrent through the difference in the superconducting critical current (Ic) between forward and reverse current directions. For bringing such SDs closer to practical superconducting power electronics applications, a combination of both high rectification efficiency (η) and a large Ic difference (ΔIc) is required. Here, we propose and demonstrate a coil-shaped superconducting wire device concept to induce a large SD effect, arising from the compensation between an external magnetic field (Hext) and the field generated by the coil itself. From transport Ic measurements on coil-shaped SDs based on a Sn10-Pb90 solder wire, we achieved a η of 79% with a ΔIc of 140 A at Hext = 500 Oe (coil #2) and a η of 84% with a ΔIc of 125 A at Hext = 530 Oe (coil #3), confirming high rectification values at large supercurrents. The large-current high-efficiency SDE in the coil-shaped SDs will be highly useful for developing the potential field of supercurrent power electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验研究；基于线圈状超导焊料的输运临界电流测量；研究对象：基于Sn10-Pb90焊料的线圈状超导二极管（coil #2、coil #3）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线圈状超导焊料器件在外磁场下实现大超电流整流，coil #2在500 Oe下η=79%、ΔIc=140 A，coil #3在530 Oe下η=84%、ΔIc=125 A。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何同时获得高超电流整流效率η和大的正反向临界电流差ΔIc，以推动超导二极管走向超导电力电子应用。
证据与比较：摘要报告了线圈状超导二极管的输运Ic测量结果：coil #2在Hext=500 Oe时η=79%、ΔIc=140 A；coil #3在Hext=530 Oe时η=84%、ΔIc=125 A。
papers.method_zh: 提出并制备线圈状超导焊料线器件，通过输运临界电流Ic测量评估正反向超电流整流特性。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出并演示线圈状超导导线器件概念，利用外磁场与线圈自身磁场的补偿来诱导大的超导二极管效应。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要仅给出Sn10-Pb90焊料线圈在特定外磁场下的结果；未说明温度、器件尺寸、重复性及长期稳定性等条件。

papers.title: Assessing the Reliability of Foundational Machine Learning Potentials for Evaluating the Veracity of the Crystallography Open Database
papers.abstract: The Crystallography Open Database (COD) contains over half a million experimentally determined crystal structures. Validation of crystallographic data proceeds at three hierarchical levels, the third of which assesses the physical plausibility of structures. This level has typically relied on empirical heuristics or expert judgment, which are slow and error-prone given the size of crystallographic databases and the rate at which new structures are deposited. Here we assess whether universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can automate this level of validation. Of the 522 086 COD entries, 317 457 (60.8\%) passed a data-quality filter removing disordered structures, formula mismatches and unmodelled solvent. These structures were relaxed with M3GNet, and 314 153 (99.0\%) converged without a large change in cell volume. For most entries the relaxed and deposited volumes are nearly identical. Convergence and volume change thus provide simple criteria for identifying relaxations that do not confirm the deposited structure. A manual inspection of 327 structures showed that no single descriptor threshold (energy, largest force, or atomic displacement) separates valid from invalid structures. A comparison of M3GNet, CHGNet, PET-MAD and PET-OAM on 524 selected structures revealed model-specific failures: M3GNet distorts cyclopentadienyl and other $π$ ligands, and both M3GNet and CHGNet distort thiophene and thiazole rings, whereas the PET models preserve these motifs. All models detected missing hydrogen atoms, and at least some detected spurious hydrogens, incorrectly assigned atom types, and two previously unreported coordinate errors. No single model detected all error types. MLIP relaxation is therefore a useful but model-dependent screening tool, and combining several models is preferable to relying on any single one.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算评估，基于MLIP对COD结构做弛豫与多模型比较；研究对象：晶体学开放数据库（COD）中522086条实验晶体结构，经筛选后317457条
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势可自动筛查COD结构物理合理性，但结果依赖具体模型，多模型组合优于单一模型。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否用通用机器学习原子间势自动化COD第三层级（物理合理性）的晶体学数据验证？
证据与比较：317457条通过质量筛选；M3GNet弛豫后314153条（99.0%）收敛且晶胞体积无大变化；327条人工检查显示无单一描述符阈值可区分有效与无效结构；524条上比较M3GNet、CHGNet、PET-MAD、PET-OAM发现模型特异性失败。
papers.method_zh: 用M3GNet弛豫COD结构，以收敛性和体积变化为判据；人工检查327条；在524条结构上比较四种MLIP。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者摘要称评估通用MLIP能否自动化晶体学数据第三层级验证，并比较多种模型识别模型特异性失败。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明MLIP训练集覆盖范围、计算资源、筛选标准细节及人工检查的抽样方式；结论限于所测试模型与COD条目。

papers.title: Enhancement of the Topological Hall Effect through Engineering the Skyrmion Size and Shape
papers.abstract: The topological Hall effect of skyrmions is a promising electrical probe of magnetic textures, but its small magnitude limits applications. In this work, we theoretically investigate the topological Hall effect induced by sparsely distributed skyrmions in the weak-coupling limit, focusing on how the size and shape of the skyrmion affect the Hall effect. To this end, we used a formalism based on angular-momentum eigenstates, which enables systematic analysis within reasonable computation time. We found that, in clean materials where the electron mean-free path is comparable to or larger than the skyrmion size, the Hall effect depends considerably on the size and shape of the skyrmion. In particular, the Hall effect is largest when $k_Fλ\sim 1$, and its magnitude can be tuned by the domain-wall width of skyrmions. These findings provide a basis for investigating how the shape and size of skyrmions affect transport properties and demonstrate that the topological Hall effect is controllable by engineering these properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于角动量本征态形式体系进行理论计算；研究对象：弱耦合极限下稀疏分布的磁斯格明子及其诱导的拓扑霍尔效应
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电子平均自由程与斯格明子尺寸相当或更大的洁净材料中，拓扑霍尔效应显著依赖斯格明子尺寸与形状，并在k_Fλ~1时最大，其大小可通过畴壁宽度调控。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：斯格明子的尺寸和形状如何影响其诱导的拓扑霍尔效应，以及该效应能否通过调控这些几何属性来增强。
证据与比较：摘要报告：在洁净材料中电子平均自由程与斯格明子尺寸相当或更大时，霍尔效应随尺寸和形状显著变化；霍尔效应在k_Fλ~1时最大；其大小可由斯格明子畴壁宽度调节。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于角动量本征态的形式体系，在弱耦合极限下理论计算稀疏分布斯格明子诱导的拓扑霍尔效应。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称：所采用的形式体系可在合理计算时间内进行系统分析，并证明拓扑霍尔效应可通过工程化斯格明子尺寸和形状进行调控。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要限定于弱耦合极限、稀疏分布斯格明子及洁净材料；未提供具体材料、温度或定量数值，也未说明其他散射机制的影响。

papers.title: Markov length can diverge in systems whose universal physics is spatially Markovian
papers.abstract: Conditional mutual information (CMI) probes spatial non-Markovianity and plays a central role in a recently developed framework for defining mixed-state phases based on local reversibility. This framework sharply distinguishes exponentially decaying from algebraically decaying CMI, since the latter obstructs equivalence to a state with finite Markov length. Here we show that states that flow to the same renormalization-group (RG) fixed point can nevertheless exhibit qualitatively different CMI. Starting from a critical Gibbs state of a finite-range local classical Hamiltonian, whose CMI vanishes beyond the interaction range, we show that an RG-irrelevant perturbation that breaks detailed balance generically generates algebraically decaying CMI. Crucially, these power-law tails are cutoff-suppressed: although they lead to an infinite Markov length at every fixed lattice cutoff, they vanish as a positive power of the cutoff in the continuum limit. We construct solvable models that exhibit this phenomenon and predict that the Ising-symmetric critical point of Toom's cellular automata generically exhibits such behavior. We also find analogous cutoff-suppressed CMI in the high-temperature paramagnetic phase of the long-range Ising paramagnet, in contrast with the genuine power-law CMI at the finite-temperature critical point in this same model that survives the continuum limit. We also derive a general result that in one spatial dimension, CMI decays faster than the inverse square of the buffer length if and only if the long-distance physics is Markovian.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算，基于可解模型和一般性推导。；研究对象：有限程局域经典哈密顿量的临界吉布斯态、Toom元胞自动机、长程Ising顺磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 流向同一重整化群不动点的态可具有定性不同的条件互信息；破坏细致平衡的重整化群无关微扰可产生代数衰减的条件互信息，但其幂律尾在连续极限下被截断压低。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：空间非马尔可夫性（条件互信息）是否完全由重整化群不动点决定，以及截断如何影响其标度行为。
证据与比较：从条件互信息超出相互作用程即消失的临界吉布斯态出发，显示重整化群无关微扰产生代数衰减条件互信息；这些尾在固定截断下导致无限马尔可夫长度，但在连续极限下以截断的正幂次消失；并给出一维中条件互信息衰减快于缓冲长度平方倒数当且仅当长距离物理马尔可夫的一般结果。
papers.method_zh: 构造可解模型，分析条件互信息在重整化群流和连续极限下的行为，并推导一维一般性判据。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称展示流向同一重整化群不动点的态可有定性不同的条件互信息，并预测Toom元胞自动机的Ising对称临界点普遍表现该行为。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明可解模型的具体参数范围、数值验证细节及Toom元胞自动机预测的适用条件；未提供全文实验或数值数据。

papers.title: Localization of Candidate Kikuchi Regions in RHEED Images: Visibility and Annotation Boundaries
papers.abstract: Kikuchi lines and bands in reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) carry information on crystal geometry and electron scattering, but are often obscured by intense diffraction streaks. We combine multiscale convolution with spatial detail from skip connections and independent supervision that allows overlapping regions to localize streaks and candidate Kikuchi regions separately. Using manual polygon annotations made before model-assisted editing, the Kikuchi intersection-over-union (IoU) on 29 laboratory test images from separate growth batches was $0.6290 \pm 0.0137$. We then performed supervised adaptation to public chalcogenide images and stratified images by Kikuchi visibility using the median ratings of three observers who rated the images separately, two of whom rated with predictions hidden. With all 244 training images, IoU for the clear-feature group of 10 test images was $0.5014 \pm 0.0336$, whereas ambiguous images gave lower values. With 100 training images, clear-group IoU was $0.5171 \pm 0.0073$; expanding the training set also reduced responses on images without target features. Reported uncertainties are sample standard deviations across four laboratory runs or three adaptation runs. Public-image adaptation used reference masks of mixed provenance, including prediction-derived drafts. The method converts visual cues into inspectable spatial regions, providing a basis for analysis of line positions, intersections, and local intensity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法研究；摘要为图像分割模型与实验图像评估；研究对象：RHEED图像中的Kikuchi线与带、衍射条纹，以及硫系化合物公开图像
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合多尺度卷积、跳跃连接空间细节与独立监督，可分别定位条纹与候选Kikuchi区域，并在实验室与公开图像上给出可检验的IoU表现。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何在RHEED图像中把被强衍射条纹遮挡的Kikuchi线与带转化为可定位、可检查的空间区域，并区分条纹与候选Kikuchi区域？
证据与比较：29张独立生长批次实验室测试图像上Kikuchi IoU为0.6290±0.0137；公开硫系图像监督适配后，244张训练时清晰特征组10张测试IoU为0.5014±0.0336，模糊图像更低；100张训练时清晰组IoU为0.5171±0.0073；不确定性为四次实验室运行或三次适配运行的样本标准差。
papers.method_zh: 多尺度卷积结合跳跃连接空间细节，并采用独立监督使重叠区域分别定位条纹与候选Kikuchi区域；使用人工多边形标注，并进行公开硫系图像监督适配与按可见性分层评估。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者称该方法将视觉线索转化为可检查的空间区域，为分析线位置、交点和局部强度提供基础；摘要未明确说明其他创新性表述。
papers.limitations_zh: 公开图像适配使用来源混合的参考掩膜，包括由预测生成的草稿；评估依赖人工标注与观察者评分；摘要未明确说明更广泛材料、成像条件或跨设备泛化能力。

papers.title: Giant Magnetization Enhancement at Ultrathin Limit of an Orthoferrite
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional magnetic systems have received significant interest due to their high scalability and energy efficiency for future electromagnetic applications. However, low-dimensional magnetism at finite temperature is subject to Mermin-Wagner fluctuations, which make its realization highly challenging. Here, we propose structural modulation in the thin-film structure of an orthoferrite system to achieve a high low-dimensional magnetic response at room temperature. ErFeO3 epitaxial thin film with atomically precise thickness control demonstrates that the magnetic response at 300 K can be significantly enhanced compared to its bulk counterpart. The magnetic response reaches its maximum value of 3.7 MuB/f.u. for the 2 nm-thick epitaxial film. The characteristic domain structure resulting from epitaxial strain and orbital reconstruction at the surface, both arising from the thin film geometry, has been proposed as the microscopic origin of the giant magnetization enhancement. We show that magnetic ordering can indeed be realized in the 2D limit, with deliberate structural control of orthoferrite systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验，基于外延薄膜制备与磁性测量；研究对象：ErFeO3外延薄膜，厚度可控至原子级精度
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 2 nm厚ErFeO3外延薄膜在300 K的磁响应显著增强，最大达3.7 μB/f.u.，表明二维极限下可实现磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何在有限温度下克服Mermin-Wagner涨落，在二维极限实现正交铁氧体的室温磁有序？
证据与比较：摘要给出2 nm厚外延薄膜在300 K的磁响应最大值为3.7 μB/f.u.，并称其显著高于块体对应物；未提供具体测量手段、误差或对比数据。
papers.method_zh: 对正交铁氧体薄膜结构进行结构调制，采用原子级精确厚度控制的外延薄膜生长与磁响应测量。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出通过薄膜几何引起的结构调制，在正交铁氧体体系中实现室温低维磁响应增强。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明测量方法、温度依赖细节、样品具体生长条件及块体对比数据；微观机制为作者提出的解释，未提供直接验证。

papers.title: Light-induced interlayer spacing dynamics via orbital phonon coupling
papers.abstract: Interlayer coupling controls the electronic properties of layered van der Waals transition metal dichalcogenides. We investigate light-induced control of the interlayer spacing through orbital-selective excitation in trilayer 1T'-WSe2 and 1T'-WS2. Real-time time-dependent density functional theory simulations show that the interlayer spacing contracts or expands depending on whether chalcogen p-orbital density is depleted from or accumulated in the interlayer region. Effective Lindblad models coupled to the lattice dynamics reproduce these contrasting responses with simplified dynamics. A single effective excited state captures the cosine-like displacive motion in trilayer 1T'-WSe2, whereas the shift of the equilibrium spacing in trilayer 1T'-WS2 requires two excited states with different electron-phonon couplings and relaxation channels. Static calculations at varied interlayer spacings indicate that these spacing changes modify the electronic gaps and could access different electronic phases. These results connect orbital redistribution, carrier relaxation, and interlayer breathing motion, and establish orbital-selective optical excitation as a route to tuning the electronic properties of layered materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究，基于实时含时密度泛函理论模拟。；研究对象：三层1T'-WSe2和1T'-WS2范德华过渡金属硫族化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 轨道选择性激发可通过硫族p轨道密度在层间区域的增减，使层间距收缩或膨胀，从而调控电子性质。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否通过轨道选择性光激发控制范德华过渡金属硫族化合物的层间距，并理解其与载流子弛豫和层间呼吸运动的联系。
证据与比较：实时含时密度泛函理论显示层间距随硫族p轨道密度在层间区域耗尽或积累而收缩或膨胀；有效Lindblad模型复现相反响应；1T'-WSe2用单激发态描述余弦式位移运动，1T'-WS2需两个具有不同电声耦合和弛豫通道的激发态；不同层间距静态计算表明带隙改变。
papers.method_zh: 实时含时密度泛函理论模拟、有效Lindblad模型耦合晶格动力学、不同层间距的静态计算。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称将轨道再分布、载流子弛豫和层间呼吸运动联系起来，并确立轨道选择性光激发作为调控层状材料电子性质的途径。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体激发条件、层间距变化幅度、时间尺度及实验验证情况；结论基于计算模拟。

papers.title: Cooperative STT and SOT switching in perpendicular magnetic tunnel junctions: Role of the pulse-end magnetization state
papers.abstract: Spin--orbit torque MRAM (SOT-MRAM) is a leading candidate for next-generation nonvolatile memory, offering high speed, endurance, and architectural compatibility. However, in conventional SOT switching, the magnetization remains near the in-plane region at pulse termination, making the final state highly sensitive to post-pulse relaxation dynamics and prone to back-switching. To overcome this, we propose a field-free scheme in which the transverse SOT drives large-angle precessional excitation while the perpendicular spin-transfer torque (STT) biases the trajectory toward the reversed $-z$ state. Micromagnetic simulations reveal a nonlinear switching boundary in the $J_{\mathrm{STT}}$--$J_{\mathrm{SOT}}$ parameter space, originating from the distinct dynamical roles of the two torques: SOT primarily governs the excitation and crossing of the dynamical separatrix, whereas STT controls the terminal trajectory and final-state selection. An analytical macrospin model, based on the stability analysis of the current-induced equilibrium, reproduces the critical-boundary trends as functions of current density, Gilbert damping $α$, and uniaxial anisotropy $K_\mathrm{u}$, and distinguishes dynamic anti-damping and static instability branches. Systematic analyses of pulse duration, damping, anisotropy, and the STT--SOT balance further demonstrate that reliable ultrafast switching requires not only sufficient excitation to cross the separatrix before pulse termination, but also precise control of the pulse-end magnetization state to minimize post-pulse relaxation. These results establish that the pulse-end state, rather than the instantaneous torque amplitude, is the decisive factor governing switching speed and reliability in coupled STT--SOT systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论结合；摘要提及微磁模拟和解析宏自旋模型；研究对象：垂直磁隧道结中的STT与SOT协同切换
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脉冲结束时的磁化状态，而非瞬时力矩幅度，是决定耦合STT-SOT系统切换速度和可靠性的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何克服传统SOT切换中脉冲结束时磁化接近面内、易受脉冲后弛豫影响和回切的问题？
证据与比较：微磁模拟显示J_STT-J_SOT参数空间存在非线性切换边界；解析宏自旋模型复现临界边界随电流密度、Gilbert阻尼α和单轴各向异性K_u的变化趋势，并区分动态反阻尼与静态失稳分支。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟与基于电流诱导平衡态稳定性分析的解析宏自旋模型。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出无外场方案，横向SOT驱动大角度进动激发，垂直STT将轨迹偏置向反转-z态。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体材料参数、样品条件或实验验证；结论基于模拟和解析模型。

papers.title: Universal Drude Weights in One-dimensional Repulsive Fermi Gas
papers.abstract: Building on the Bethe ansatz and generalized hydrodynamics, we rigorously establish universal relations between Drude weights governing charge, spin, and energy transport and thermodynamic properties for the one-dimensional repulsive two-component continuum Fermi gas - the paradigmatic integrable Yang-Gaudin model. We analytically derive thermodynamic expressions for charge Drude weights: $D_{nn}$, $D_{nm}$, $D_{ne}$ (responses of particle, magnetization and energy currents to a chemical potential gradient) equal the particle density, magnetization, and temperature times entropy density, respectively. These relations constitute a hallmark of ballistic transport, and can be generalized to other 1D continuum integrable systems. Furthermore, we investigate spin Drude weight ($D_{mm}$, $D_{me}$) at zero and low temperatures. They characterize the magnetization and energy current responses to a magnetic field gradient, revealing an essential spin-charge coupling feature in quantum transport. We find that the Drude weights $D_{nm}$, $D_{mm}$, and $D_{me}$ across the $μ\text{-}H$ plane remarkably map out the zero-temperature phase boundary. This work fills a critical gap in the understanding of transport within integrable quantum gases and furnishes a direct theoretical foundation for future ultracold-atom experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于Bethe ansatz和广义流体力学；研究对象：一维排斥两分量连续费米气体（Yang-Gaudin模型）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 严格建立了电荷、自旋和能量输运的Drude权重与热力学性质之间的普适关系，并发现部分Drude权重可映射零温相边界。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何严格建立一维排斥费米气体中电荷、自旋和能量输运的Drude权重与热力学性质之间的普适关系？
证据与比较：解析推导出电荷Drude权重D_nn、D_nm、D_ne分别等于粒子密度、磁化强度和温度乘以熵密度；在零温和低温下研究了自旋Drude权重D_mm、D_me；发现D_nm、D_mm、D_me在μ-H平面上映射出零温相边界。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bethe ansatz和广义流体力学进行解析推导。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称严格建立了Drude权重与热力学性质的普适关系，填补了可积量子气体输运理解的空白，并为未来超冷原子实验提供理论基础。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明适用条件；未提供具体数值或实验验证；仅针对一维连续可积系统，推广性需进一步研究。

papers.title: Probing and Manipulating Quantum Materials with Strong-field Terahertz and Mid-infrared Radiation
papers.abstract: Emergent phenomena in quantum materials arise from interactions among different degrees of freedom. Identifying these interactions and establishing their roles in ordered states are central problems in condensed-matter physics and provide a basis for controlling material properties. Many relevant low-energy excitations and gaps lie in the terahertz (THz) and mid-infrared (MIR) range, where intense phase-stable fields can both interrogate nonlinear dynamics and drive selected degrees of freedom far from equilibrium. This review surveys recent progress in probing and manipulating quantum materials with strong-field THz and MIR radiation, with emphasis on nonlinear electronic dynamics, collective-mode coupling, symmetry-sensitive responses and field-induced changes in electronic structure and ordered states. Particular attention is given to developments enabled by the Synergetic Extreme Condition User Facility (SECUF).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述；标题与摘要表明为领域进展综述；研究对象：量子材料中的低能激发、集体模式与有序态
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强场太赫兹与中红外辐射可用于探测量子材料的非线性动力学、集体模式耦合及对称敏感响应，并驱动特定自由度远离平衡，从而调控电子结构与有序态。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何利用强场太赫兹和中红外辐射识别量子材料中不同自由度间的相互作用，并以此探测和调控其有序态？
证据与比较：摘要为综述性概述，未提供具体测量数据、样品比较或定量证据；仅指出相关低能激发和能隙位于太赫兹与中红外波段。
papers.method_zh: 综述强场太赫兹与中红外辐射探测和调控量子材料的研究进展，强调SECUF设施推动的相关发展。

papers.title: High-resolution mapping of the phase boundary of the honeycomb-lattice Blume--Capel ferromagnet
papers.abstract: We present a high-resolution numerical study of the spin-1 Blume--Capel ferromagnet on the honeycomb lattice ($z=3$). Wang--Landau estimates of the joint density of states $Ω(E_1,E_2)$, combined with field mixing, are used to map the first-order transition line and locate the tricritical point at $(Δ_t,T_t)=[1.4819(2),\,0.4022(7)]$. Histogram reweighting of Metropolis simulations for $L=36$ and $48$ provides an independent consistency check, with a crossing temperature near $0.4039$, compatible with the Wang--Landau extrapolation. From the field-mixing analysis we obtain $r=-1.586(19)$, while the slope of the multicanonical coexistence line yields the consistent and more precise estimate $r=-1.587(5)$. Normalizing by the zero-temperature field $Δ_0=zJ/2$, the available honeycomb, square, triangular, and simple-cubic estimates cluster near $r/Δ_0\simeq-1.06$, corresponding to a magnitude about $6\%$ larger than the mean-field value $-1$; no systematic dependence on coordination number or dimensionality is resolved over the range examined. Finite-size scaling of $σ_Q$ gives $y_t=1.795(7)$, consistent with the tricritical Ising value $9/5$, while the fourth-order cumulant scaling is compatible with $y_g=4/5$. Deep in the first-order regime, the cumulant approaches the expected two-phase limit $U_Q\to2/3$. Multicanonical simulations up to $L=64$, using weights constructed directly from the Wang--Landau density of states for $L\le24$ and rescaled and refined for larger systems, yield an interface-tension exponent $μ=1.265(26)$, consistent with the tricritical prediction $(d-1)/y_g=5/4$. Finally, we map the continuous branch of the phase boundary from the same density-of-states data, obtaining $T_c(Δ=0)=1.157$; estimates sufficiently close to the tricritical point are affected by crossover from Ising to tricritical scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究，基于Wang-Landau和Metropolis模拟。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格（z=3）上的自旋-1 Blume-Capel铁磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高分辨率映射了一级相变线和三临界点，三临界点位于(Δt,Tt)=[1.4819(2),0.4022(7)]，并得到场混合比r=-1.587(5)等临界指数。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何高精度确定蜂窝晶格Blume-Capel铁磁体的相边界、三临界点位置及临界行为？
证据与比较：Wang-Landau联合态密度估计给出三临界点(Δt,Tt)=[1.4819(2),0.4022(7)]；直方图重加权L=36和48的交叉温度约0.4039；场混合分析得r=-1.586(19)，多正则共存线斜率得r=-1.587(5)；有限尺寸标度得yt=1.795(7)，yg=4/5，μ=1.265(26)。
papers.method_zh: Wang-Landau联合态密度估计、场混合分析、直方图重加权Metropolis模拟、多正则模拟及有限尺寸标度。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者未在摘要中明确声称创新性，仅报告高分辨率数值结果。

papers.title: Bond-Switching Reconstruction in Bare Ti3C2 MXene
papers.abstract: MXene properties are typically tuned through composition, surface termination, and intercalation, while the metal-carbon framework topology is considered fixed. Here, we demonstrate that this framework can reconstruct. Unconstrained relaxations of biaxially strained bare Ti3C2 yield a dynamically stable polymorph, N, featuring a 15-atom primitive cell, six distinct Ti-C bond classes, and 2.55 Å Ti-Ti pairs. The coherent transformation pathway crosses an 8.47 eV barrier per cell but first reaches another reconstructed minimum, N', lying 1.08 eV below N, revealing a family of bond-switched networks. Phase N lies 7.58 eV per cell above the parent. Reverse barriers along the calculated pathway are 1.50 and 1.98 eV per cell for N and N', respectively. Reconstruction quenches the parent spin polarization, yielding a nonmagnetic metal with a nearly fourfold increase in Fermi-level density of states. Bader and electron-localization analyses suggest charge redistribution from C toward Ti associated with Ti-Ti pairing. In multilayers, reconstructed layers form interlayer Ti-C bonds. A 10% biaxial tension halves the phase-energy difference, and pressure reverses phase ordering near 85 GPa. These results establish bond-switching reconstruction as a mechanically controllable structural degree of freedom in MXenes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究，基于第一性原理的未约束弛豫与路径计算；研究对象：裸Ti3C2 MXene及其双轴应变下的重构相
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 裸Ti3C2的金属-碳骨架可通过键切换重构为动态稳定的新相N和N'，重构淬灭自旋极化并显著提高费米能级态密度。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：MXene的金属-碳骨架拓扑是否固定，能否通过机械应变诱导重构并改变其电子结构？
证据与比较：双轴应变下未约束弛豫得到动态稳定N相，原胞15原子、6类Ti-C键、Ti-Ti对2.55 Å；转变路径跨越8.47 eV/胞势垒，先到N'（比N低1.08 eV）；N比母相高7.58 eV/胞；反向势垒N和N'分别为1.50和1.98 eV/胞；重构后非磁性金属，费米能级态密度增加近四倍；Bader和电子局域化分析表明电荷从C向Ti转移；多层中重构层形成层间Ti-C键；10%双轴拉伸使相能差减半，约85 GPa压力反转相序。
papers.method_zh: 未约束弛豫、动态稳定性计算、转变路径与势垒计算、Bader和电子局域化分析，考虑双轴应变、多层和压力。

papers.title: Three-dimensional dopant distribution from a single, out-of-focus spectroscopic image
papers.abstract: Increasing miniaturization of nanoscale devices makes determining the three-dimensional distribution of dopants increasingly important. In out-of-focus spectroscopic scanning transmission electron microscopy images, we show that dopant atoms appear as disks with radii relating to dopant depth, allowing the three-dimensional distribution of dopants to be determined from simple geometric analysis of a single out-of-focus image. Through numerical experiments on Si-doped graphene we validate statistical detection and Bayesian inference methods to quantify confidence and uncertainties while making the analysis more robust at lower dose. We present proof-of-concept experimental data from an Fe-doped spinel, retrieving dopant depth to within around 2 nanometres.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合；含数值实验、贝叶斯推断与概念验证实验。；研究对象：Si掺杂石墨烯与Fe掺杂尖晶石。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单张离焦谱学STEM图像中掺杂原子呈半径与深度相关的圆盘，经几何分析可确定掺杂三维分布。

papers.title: A general framework for crystallization in maximal hard-core models
papers.abstract: We study general maximal hard-core models on periodic lattice-type graphs. While for standard models, phase coexistence may arise for high activity, for maximal models this behavior may occur also for sufficiently low activity values. Relying on the concept of volume allocation, we develop a {\em unified set of assumptions} that imply the Peierls condition, a convergent cluster expansion for the partition function, and hence the conclusions of Pirogov-Sinai theory for this class of models. We further check these assumptions for a number of examples including standard lattice-type periodic graphs, proving crystallization for both high and low activity. We also derive estimates for the values of activity that bound the phase coexistence regions in the phase diagram, rewriting for this purpose the proof of a technical result in the derivation of Pirogov-Sinai theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于数学推导与模型分析；研究对象：周期性格点型图上的最大硬核模型
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一组统一假设，可推出Peierls条件与收敛集团展开，从而将Pirogov-Sinai理论结论推广至最大硬核模型，并在多个例子中证明高、低活度下均发生结晶。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何为最大硬核模型建立统一框架，使其满足Peierls条件并适用Pirogov-Sinai理论，从而刻画相共存与结晶行为？
证据与比较：通过体积分配概念验证统一假设；对标准格点型周期图等例子检验假设，证明高、低活度下结晶；推导活度估计以界定相图中相共存区域。
papers.method_zh: 基于体积分配的统一假设、Peierls条件、收敛集团展开及Pirogov-Sinai理论，并重写技术性结果证明以推导活度估计。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称提出统一假设集，可推出Peierls条件与收敛集团展开，并将Pirogov-Sinai理论结论推广至最大硬核模型。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明假设的具体适用范围、例子细节及活度估计的定量界限；未提供全文验证。

papers.title: Reading Altermagnetic Domains with Photon Drag
papers.abstract: Finite photon momentum allows second-order photocurrents in centrosymmetric space groups, where the conventional bulk photovoltaic effect is forbidden. Here we study the photon-drag response of altermagnets and show that its angular dependence reveals both the symmetry of the magnetic order and the Néel domain of the sample. For example, when a crystal rotation exchanges the two domains, the domain-even and domain-odd parts of the current appear in different angular harmonics, $4n$ and $4n+2$ for tetragonal $d$-wave altermagnets, so that two measurements rotated by $90^\circ$ on a single domain isolate the domain-odd current. We also find that these microscopic contributions exhibit opposite domain parities depending on light polarization. Under linear light, only the shift term is domain odd, while under circular light, the domain-odd channel switches to the injection, Fermi-surface, and contact principal-value terms. Mirror symmetries fix the angular phase of each harmonic and distinguish $d_{x^2-y^2}$, $d_{xy}$, and $g$-wave order. In contrast, conventional collinear antiferromagnets show no domain-odd photon-drag current, and in tetragonal ferromagnets the two parts share the same harmonics. Although the altermagnetic spin splitting does not require spin-orbit coupling (SOC), SOC is essential to observe the domain-odd charge current. Our work uncovers distinct signatures of altermagnetism in photon drag and provides a route to all optical magnetic readouts of altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算，基于对称性分析与微观响应函数推导。；研究对象：四方d波交替磁体及其Néel畴，对比共线反铁磁与铁磁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交替磁体的光子拖曳电流角向依赖可同时揭示磁序对称性与Néel畴；畴偶与畴奇部分出现在不同角谐波，线偏振下仅shift项畴奇，圆偏振下畴奇通道转为injection、费米面与contact主值项。

papers.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
papers.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. This work provides a theoretical framework and design guidelines to navigate these fundamental limits, and to enable successful integration of 2D semiconductors into low-power nanoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论为主，结合实验对比的物理模型分析；研究对象：单层及双层二维半导体晶体管沟道
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维半导体的能带尾态导致有效迁移率降低和栅压过大的缓慢开启，构成其低功耗运行的基本限制。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：二维半导体能带尾态如何影响晶体管电学性能，以及能否通过器件设计缓解这些影响。
证据与比较：摘要给出单层二维半导体Urbach能量约100 meV、硅约10 meV的对比，并将物理电学模型与实验比较，指出尾态造成迁移率下降和开启缓慢。
papers.method_zh: 建立基于物理的电学模型并与实验对比，分析栅电容、应变工程及单层/双层沟道对尾态效应的影响。

papers.title: A nonclassical law of the wall in superfluid helium-4
papers.abstract: The logarithmic law of the wall is one of the most robust scaling laws of classical turbulence, yet whether it survives in a quantum fluid such as superfluid $^4$He (He II) remains unknown. At a solid wall, the viscous normal-fluid and inviscid superfluid components of He II obey fundamentally different boundary conditions, yet their motions can be coupled through quantized vortices. How these competing effects organize the near-wall flow remains an open question in quantum-fluid hydrodynamics. Here we visualize the near-wall velocity field in mechanically driven He II pipe flows at Reynolds numbers up to $1.26\times10^6$ using molecular tagging velocimetry and independently determine the wall shear stress from pressure-drop measurements. We find that the normal-fluid velocity develops a robust logarithmic profile, showing that a law-of-the-wall description persists despite the two-fluid nature of He II. Strikingly, however, the resulting wall law is distinctly nonclassical: the effective Kármán constant is less than half its classical value and remains nearly unchanged across the temperature range studied. This invariance, despite substantial changes in the relative fractions of the two components, indicates strong dynamical coupling between them. These results not only reveal how a universal law of classical turbulence is transformed by quantum hydrodynamics, but also provide valuable guidance for the design and operation of cryogenic cooling systems involving He II transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；摘要提及分子标记测速和压降测量。；研究对象：机械驱动的超流氦-4（He II）管流近壁区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: He II近壁法向流体速度呈稳健对数剖面，但有效卡门常数不足经典值一半，且在所研究温区内几乎不变。

研究问题：经典湍流的壁面对数律是否在超流氦-4中成立，以及两种流体组分如何组织近壁流动。

papers.title: Data driven screening of CaCu$_5$-type magnetic structures
papers.abstract: We develop a machine learning assisted workflow for the rapid screening of permanent magnet candidates within the CaCu$_5$ structure family. We generated more than 60,000 structures through substitutions. These compositions were screened using a combination of pretrained materials models, Materials Project data, and a machine-learning model for magnetization prediction. Four criteria, namely, metallicity, negative formation energy, energy above the convex hull $\leq 50$~meV/atom, and predicted magnetization above the adopted $\geq 0.75$~T threshold reduced the initial chemical space to 439 candidates for first-principles calculations. Density functional theory calculations revealed that 159 compounds exhibit positive axial magnetic anisotropy energy, favoring [001] over the tested in-plane directions. The resulting dataset reveals chemical trends in magnetic anisotropy across the CaCu$_5$ compositional space and provides a set of candidates for further investigation. More broadly, this work demonstrates a practical strategy for combining existing machine learning models with first-principles calculations to systematically reduce large chemical spaces to tractable sets for computationally intensive materials screening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/混合，摘要提及机器学习辅助工作流与第一性原理计算。；研究对象：CaCu5型结构家族的永磁候选材料，通过元素替代生成超过60000种组分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CaCu5型结构家族中，经机器学习筛选和第一性原理计算，发现159种化合物具有正轴向磁各向异性能，并揭示了该组分空间的磁各向异性化学趋势。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何从CaCu5型结构家族的大量可能组分中快速筛选出有前景的永磁候选材料，并识别其磁各向异性趋势？

papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称开发了机器学习辅助工作流，并展示了结合现有机器学习模型与第一性原理计算系统缩小大化学空间的实际策略。

papers.title: Ceramic Materials: From Atomic Bonding and Processing to Microstructure, Functional Properties, and Biomedical Applications
papers.abstract: Ceramic materials are inorganic, predominantly nonmetallic solids whose performance is governed by the interplay among atomic bonding, crystal structure, processing, microstructure, and functional properties. Their ionic and covalent bonding provides high hardness, thermal and chemical stability, wear resistance, and diverse electrical behavior, but also limits plastic deformation and increases sensitivity to flaws, porosity, grain boundaries, and residual stresses. This review examines ceramics through the processing--microstructure--property--performance relationship, emphasizing the effects of crystal chemistry, defects, grain size, porosity, and phase stability on mechanical, thermal, electrical, and biological behavior. Conventional sintering, sol--gel processing, and additive manufacturing are discussed as key routes for controlling densification, porosity, geometry, and composition. Biomedical ceramics, including alumina, zirconia, calcium phosphates, hydroxyapatite, tricalcium phosphate, and bioactive glasses, are also reviewed. Emerging topics include nanoceramics, smart ceramics, composites, multimaterial manufacturing, defect engineering, immunomodulatory bioceramics, and sustainable processing. Major challenges remain in brittle fracture, processing heterogeneity, degradation control, scale-up, and the porosity--strength trade-off. Future advances will require integrating advanced manufacturing, multiscale characterization, predictive modeling, and data-driven design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述；标题与摘要均为文献综述，无原始实验或计算数据。；研究对象：陶瓷材料，包括氧化铝、氧化锆、磷酸钙、羟基磷灰石、磷酸三钙和生物活性玻璃等。

papers.title: EPR as a probe for the mechanisms of chirality-induced spin selectivity in photoinduced charge transfer
papers.abstract: Several models for chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) in charge transfer have been proposed, but rarely compared directly with experiments. This step is essential for their validation and future progress of the field. Here we investigate a broad class of radical pair states associated with different microscopic models by computing the related electron-paramagnetic resonance spectra. This allows us to evidence peculiar signatures of different radical pair states, to study their experimental accessibility and identify conditions to verify proposed microscopic models.

papers.title: Amplitude mode in Eliashberg superconductors
papers.abstract: In the BCS theory of superconductivity the amplitude (Higgs) mode is degenerate with the pair-breaking threshold: its frequency coincides with $2Δ$, so it is an edge singularity rather than a true collective mode. This is why after a sudden weak perturbation at $t=0$ its oscillations decay algebraically as $1/\sqrt{t}$. We show that the retardation effects due to the phonon dynamics in the strong-coupling theory lift this degeneracy. The Higgs mode detaches from the pair-breaking edge $2Δ_g$, set by the spectral gap, and becomes a sharp subgap excitation. We determine its frequency from the longitudinal pair susceptibility evaluated directly on the real frequency axis, using the Eilenberger equations for Migdal--Eliashberg theory with the Einstein phonon spectrum. The response of the mass renormalization supplies at least two fifths of the displacement, and possibly all of it: with it switched off, the binding falls below the resolution of the calculation. Its consequences, however, are significant because a percent-level shift transfers about a quarter of the spectral weight of the amplitude channel out of the two-quasiparticle continuum into a discrete energy level. What experiment sees is therefore not the displacement itself but its consequence: amplitude oscillations that persist instead of decaying as $1/\sqrt{t}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算；基于Eilenberger方程和Migdal-Eliashberg理论。；研究对象：强耦合Eliashberg超导体，采用爱因斯坦声子谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子动力学引起的推迟效应使Higgs振幅模从配对破坏边缘2Δ_g分离，成为尖锐的亚能隙激发，其振幅振荡持续而非按1/√t衰减。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在强耦合Eliashberg超导体中，声子动力学引起的推迟效应是否能使原本与配对破坏阈值简并的振幅（Higgs）模脱离简并，成为真正的集体模式？
证据与比较：通过实频率轴上的纵向配对磁化率计算，发现质量重整化贡献了至少五分之二的位移；关闭该贡献后结合能低于计算分辨率。百分之一的位移将约四分之一的振幅通道谱权重从双准粒子连续谱转移到离散能级。
papers.method_zh: 使用Migdal-Eliashberg理论的Eilenberger方程，结合爱因斯坦声子谱，在实频率轴上直接计算纵向配对磁化率。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称：声子动力学引起的推迟效应提升简并，使Higgs模从2Δ_g分离并成为尖锐亚能隙激发；实验观测到的是振幅振荡持续而非1/√t衰减。

papers.title: Hierarchical Relaxation in Large-twist-angle Moire Drives Supermoire Formation
papers.abstract: Supermoire lattices in large-angle twisted bilayers have recently been shown to emerge from periodic arrangements of commensurate stacking motifs, yet the microscopic structural mechanism governing their formation has remained unresolved. Here, we uncover the microscopic origin of supermoire order as a hierarchical lattice relaxation process. Combining force-field simulations with experimental validation via super-resolution, layer-resolved multislice electron ptychography, our results identify interlayer Se-Se repulsion at the picometer scale as the driving force, giving rise to coupled short-range (about 1 nm) moire relaxation and coexisting long-range (about 10 nm) supermoire modulation. These findings demonstrate that even picometer-scale lattice relaxation remains critical in large-angle moire systems and must be explicitly considered in understanding their emergent electronic and quantum phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合：力场模拟结合电子叠层成像实验验证；研究对象：大扭转角双层Moire体系（摘要提及层间Se-Se相互作用）

证据与比较：力场模拟与超分辨、层分辨多切片电子叠层成像实验验证相结合，识别出皮米级层间Se-Se排斥为驱动力，并观察到约1 nm短程Moire弛豫与约10 nm长程超Moire调制共存。

papers.title: Supercurrent as a bulk probe for topological phase
papers.abstract: Distinguishing trivial from topological superconducting phase remains a central and contested experimental challenge, since most existing probes infer the bulk phase transition indirectly, from boundary signatures that can be sensitive to local physics. Here, we propose an alternative that probes the bulk topological phase and is based on supercurrent response. We study a one-dimensional Rashba spin-orbit-coupled superconducting nanowire with an applied magnetic field that opens a topological gap. We show that for strong spin-orbit coupling, the superfluid stiffness, and consequently the supercurrent, is suppressed by a factor of two inside the topological phase, producing a non-monotonic signature of the bulk phase transition as a function of chemical potential. We further use a low-energy helical model to understand this suppression analytically. Our results show that the bulk topological phase transition can be detected through kinetic inductance measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于模型计算与解析分析；研究对象：一维Rashba自旋轨道耦合超导纳米线，外加磁场
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强自旋轨道耦合下，拓扑相内超流刚度及超电流被抑制为原来的二分之一，随化学势呈现非单调信号，可标志体拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何直接探测超导体的体拓扑相，而非依赖可能受局部物理影响的边界信号？
证据与比较：摘要报告：强自旋轨道耦合时，拓扑相内超流刚度被抑制为二分之一，超电流相应抑制，随化学势出现非单调特征；并用低能螺旋模型解析理解该抑制。
papers.method_zh: 研究一维Rashba自旋轨道耦合超导纳米线模型，计算超流刚度与超电流，并用低能螺旋模型进行解析分析。
papers.novelty_zh: 作者提出基于超电流响应的体探针，并称可用动力学电感测量探测体拓扑相变。

papers.title: Gauging Modulated Symmetries: Bond Algebras, Higher-Form Symmetries, and Symmetry-Enriched Topological Order
papers.abstract: We develop a constructive framework for characterizing modulated symmetries and their gauging in $d$-dimensional lattice systems. The modulation profiles are organized as a finite-dimensional representation of the space group acting on a finite Abelian internal symmetry group. Since the corresponding automorphism group is finite, the nontrivial spatial action factors through a finite quotient of the space group, leading to periodic modulation patterns and providing a classification framework for discrete Abelian modulated symmetries. The symmetry-allowed local interactions are systematically obtained from a kernel construction, which also yields an algebra of open operators. Upon gauging, its elements are transmuted into extended Wilson and boundary operators while retaining their algebraic relations. In the deconfined regime, the resulting algebra realizes a mixed 't Hooft anomaly, providing a microscopic route to Abelian crystalline symmetry-enriched topological phases (SETs). These SETs do not mix electric and magnetic sectors, which transform in mutually contragredient representations, thereby preserving their braiding pairing. We illustrate the framework through explicit examples and show that several models present in the literature fit naturally within our construction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于格点模型构造框架；研究对象：d维格点系统中的调制对称性及其规范化

papers.title: Hydrodynamic Anomalous Hall Effect in a Two-Dimensional Dirac Fluid
papers.abstract: In ultraclean conductors, electron-electron collisions can make transport hydrodynamic. In a Berry-curved band, these collisions can also produce two-particle coordinate shifts, which contribute to the anomalous Hall current in the presence of a transport electric field. We develop a kinetic theory of this contribution for a two-dimensional massive Dirac Fermi liquid with weak contact interactions and weak short-range disorder. The computed response is independent of interaction strength at leading Born order. Its contribution to the anomalous Hall conductivity is comparable to the thermal correction to the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity. The existence of the momentum zero mode of the electron-electron collision integral leads to a nontrivial frequency dependence of the anomalous Hall response considered in this work. In particular, the limits of vanishing frequency (dc) and vanishing disorder do not commute. In the dc limit, the momentum response to the transport field grows inversely with the momentum relaxation rate. This allows arbitrarily weak, energy-dependent impurity scattering to produce a finite correction by coupling conserved momentum to the modes relaxed by electron-electron scattering. This correction disappears when the clean limit is taken before the zero-frequency limit. As a result, the interaction-induced Hall response retains information about the mechanism of momentum relaxation even as the overall disorder strength tends to zero.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于动理论推导二维狄拉克费米液体的输运响应；研究对象：二维有质量狄拉克费米液体，弱接触相互作用与弱短程无序
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子-电子碰撞产生的双粒子坐标移动对反常霍尔电流有贡献，其大小与内禀反常霍尔电导的热修正相当，且该响应在直流极限下随动量弛豫率反比增长，导致零频与清洁极限不可交换。

papers.title: Resolving the interfacial mechanical landscape of monolayer NbSe2 grown by confined epitaxy
papers.abstract: Confined epitaxy has recently emerged as a novel methodology for controlled growth of high-quality monolayer two-dimensional (2D) materials. However, mechanistic understanding remains limited to analysing nucleus adsorption and diffusion barriers. Here, I discover that van der Waals (vdW) confinement not only affects the specific adsorption and diffusion of nuclei on confined substrates but also induces strong coupling to atomic forces at the interface. Using artificial intelligence (AI) assisted density functional theory (DFT) calculations, I study how vdW confinement couples to the atomic motion of monolayer NbSe2 grown between c-plane sapphire and hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN). The calculated force-electronic landscape yields large mechanical forces of +0.070 and -0.04 eV per Angstrom on Nb and Se, respectively, giving rise to a unit-cell interfacial interaction energy up to 2.4 eV, comparable to reported adsorption and diffusion energies on similar substrates. The results indicate that interfacial mechanics may explain the success of confined epitaxy. The findings suggest that tuning interfacial mechanics, and related vdW mechanochemistry, could be a promising route to high-throughput, high-quality materials synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；摘要明确使用AI辅助DFT计算。；研究对象：受限外延生长的单层NbSe2，位于c面蓝宝石与h-BN之间。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: vdW限域不仅影响晶核吸附与扩散，还诱导界面原子力强耦合，界面力学可能解释受限外延的成功。
